requirements.text: The vehicle conforming to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation shall have affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, an international approval mark conforming to the model described in Annex 2, consisting of a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval, and the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle and check that the approval mark is affixed conspicuously at the place given on the approval form and matches the Annex 2 model with the E-circle, country number, "127R", dash and approval number.

requirements.text: Where the vehicle conforms to a vehicle type approved under one or more other Regulations, annexed to the Agreement, in the country which has granted approval under this Regulation, the Regulation and approval numbers and the additional symbols shall be placed in vertical columns to the right of the symbol prescribed in paragraph 4.4.1., except that the symbol prescribed in paragraph 4.4.1. needs not be repeated.
requirements.test_case: Inspect a combined approval mark and check that the Regulation and approval numbers and additional symbols are arranged in vertical columns to the right of a single E-circle.

requirements.text: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and be indelible.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark for legibility and rub it with a solvent-soaked cloth to confirm it cannot be removed.

requirements.text: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle and confirm that the approval mark is located on or next to the vehicle data plate.

requirements.text: For the legform test to bumper, for vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position of less than 425 mm, the requirements of paragraph 5.1.1. shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower bumper height at each test position and confirm that the flexible lower legform test of paragraph 5.1.1. is applied where it is below 425 mm.

requirements.text: For the legform test to bumper, for vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position which is greater than, or equal to, 425 mm and less than 500 mm, the requirements of either paragraph 5.1.1. or 5.1.2., at the choice of the manufacturer, shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower bumper height at each test position and, where it is from 425 mm to below 500 mm, confirm that the test of paragraph 5.1.1. or 5.1.2. chosen by the manufacturer is applied.

requirements.text: For the legform test to bumper, for vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position of greater than, or equal to, 500 mm, the requirements of paragraph 5.1.2. shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower bumper height at each test position and confirm that the upper legform to bumper test of paragraph 5.1.2. is applied where it is 500 mm or more.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor), the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 22 mm.
requirements.test_case: Perform the flexible lower legform to bumper impacts per Annex 5 paragraph 1 and check that the peak absolute MCL elongation is no more than 22 mm at every test point.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor), the maximum dynamic anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament elongation shall not exceed 13 mm.
requirements.test_case: Perform the flexible lower legform to bumper impacts per Annex 5 paragraph 1 and check that the peak ACL and PCL elongations are each no more than 13 mm at every test point.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor), the absolute value of dynamic bending moments at the tibia shall not exceed 340 Nm, except that the manufacturer may nominate bumper test widths up to a maximum of 264 mm in total where the absolute value of the tibia bending moment shall not exceed 380 Nm.
requirements.test_case: Perform the flexible lower legform to bumper impacts and check that the peak absolute tibia bending moment is no more than 340 Nm outside the nominated relaxation widths.

requirements.text: Where the manufacturer nominates bumper test widths up to a maximum of 264 mm in total, the absolute value of the tibia bending moment in the nominated bumper test widths shall not exceed 380 Nm, unless a Contracting Party restricts application of the relaxation zone requirement in its domestic legislation.
requirements.test_case: Check that the nominated relaxation widths add up to no more than 264 mm and that the peak absolute tibia bending moment measured there is no more than 380 Nm.

requirements.text: The flexible lower legform impactor shall be certified pursuant to Annex 6, paragraph 1.
requirements.test_case: Review the certification records of the flexible lower legform impactor used and confirm that it was certified per Annex 6 paragraph 1.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 2. (upper legform to bumper), the instantaneous sum of the impact forces with respect to time shall not exceed 7.5 kN.
requirements.test_case: Perform the upper legform to bumper impacts per Annex 5 paragraph 2 and check that the instantaneous sum of the two load transducer forces never exceeds 7.5 kN.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 2. (upper legform to bumper), the bending moment on the test impactor shall not exceed 510 Nm.
requirements.test_case: Perform the upper legform to bumper impacts per Annex 5 paragraph 2 and check that none of the strain gauge bending moments exceeds 510 Nm.

requirements.text: The upper legform impactor shall be certified pursuant to Annex 6, paragraph 2.
requirements.test_case: Review the certification records of the upper legform impactor used and confirm that it was certified per Annex 6 paragraph 2.

requirements.text: Where a vehicle is fitted with an ARHSS which could change the vehicle height at the front axle more than 20 mm from the nominal for any vehicle speed between 25 and 40 km/h, the provisions of paragraphs 5.1. and 5.2. shall, in addition to the normal running condition as specified by the manufacturer for a vehicle speed of 40 km/h, be met for all adjustable vehicle steady heights corresponding to vehicle speeds from 25 up to 40 km/h.
requirements.test_case: For a vehicle with such an ARHSS, repeat the legform to bumper and headform assessments at every adjustable steady height for 25 to 40 km/h and check that the limits of paragraphs 5.1. and 5.2. are met.

requirements.text: For the tests of a vehicle fitted with an ARHSS at the adjustable vehicle steady heights, on request of the manufacturer and agreed by the technical service, either the impact speeds defined in paragraphs 5.1. and 5.2. or the impact speed corresponding to the adjusted vehicle height shall be used.
requirements.test_case: Review the ARHSS test plan and report and confirm that either the impact speeds of paragraphs 5.1. and 5.2. or the speed matching the adjusted height, as agreed with the technical service, was used.

requirements.text: Where the impact speed corresponding to the adjusted vehicle height is used, the ratio of the head impact vs. the corresponding vehicle velocity shall be 0.9.
requirements.test_case: Check in the test report that the head impact speed used equals 0.9 times the vehicle speed matching the adjusted height.

requirements.text: Where the vehicle is equipped with an ARHSS fully corresponding to the conditions of paragraph 5.3.1.1. or 5.3.1.2., the requirements of paragraph 5.3. shall be deemed to be fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Review the evidence that the ARHSS fully meets the conditions of paragraph 5.3.1.1. or 5.3.1.2. before waiving the additional ride-height tests of paragraph 5.3.

requirements.text: For the tests of a vehicle fitted with an ARHSS, the legform impactor to be used shall be the legform impactor as used for the legform to bumper test in normal running conditions for a speed of 40 km/h.
requirements.test_case: Confirm that the legform impactor used in the ARHSS ride-height tests is the same type as the one used for the 40 km/h normal running condition test.

requirements.text: For a vehicle fitted with an ARHSS, with the agreement of the technical service, compliance shall be demonstrated by a limited number of legform tests or by numerical simulation according to the specification set out in paragraph 5.3, so that the biomechanical limits set out in paragraph 5.1.1. and paragraph 5.1.2. respectively are met.
requirements.test_case: Review the limited legform tests or validated numerical simulations agreed with the technical service and confirm that they show the limits of paragraphs 5.1.1. and 5.1.2. are met at all ARHSS heights.

requirements.text: For a vehicle fitted with an ARHSS, with the agreement of the technical service, compliance shall be demonstrated by a limited number of head impact tests or by numerical simulation showing compliance to the HIC 1,700 requirement on the additional head test area.
requirements.test_case: Review the limited head impact tests or numerical simulations agreed with the technical service and confirm that HIC is no more than 1,700 on the additional head test area.

requirements.text: The vehicle approved pursuant to this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements of paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Test production vehicles or bumper samples to the paragraph 5 legform (and headform) procedures and check that the results still meet the limits.

requirements.text: At the time of testing, the test facility and the vehicle or sub-system shall have a relative humidity of 40 per cent ± 30 per cent and stabilized temperature of 20 ºC ± 4 ºC.
requirements.test_case: Record the humidity and temperature of the test facility and the vehicle or bumper sub-system at the time of each impact and check that they are 40 % ± 30 % and 20 ºC ± 4 ºC.

requirements.text: For the test, either a complete vehicle, or a cut-body, adjusted to the conditions of paragraphs 3.1.1. and 3.1.2. of Annex 3 shall be used.
requirements.test_case: Check that the test object is a complete vehicle or a cut-body prepared according to Annex 3 paragraphs 3.1.1. and 3.1.2.

requirements.text: For the test, the vehicle shall be in its normal ride attitude.
requirements.test_case: Measure the vehicle ride heights before testing and confirm that they correspond to the normal ride attitude.

requirements.text: For the test, the vehicle shall be either securely mounted on raised supports or at rest on a flat horizontal surface with the parking brake applied.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the test set-up and confirm that the vehicle is either securely mounted on raised supports or standing on a flat horizontal surface with the parking brake applied.

requirements.text: The cut-body shall include, in the test, all parts of the vehicle front structure, all under-bonnet components and all components behind the windscreen that may be involved in a frontal impact with a vulnerable road user, to demonstrate the performance and interactions of all the contributory vehicle components.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the cut-body and confirm that it contains the complete bumper module, front structure, under-bonnet components and components behind the windscreen that may be involved in the impact.

requirements.text: The cut-body shall be securely mounted in the normal vehicle ride attitude.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the cut-body mounting and measure its position to confirm that it is rigidly fixed at the normal vehicle ride attitude.

requirements.text: All devices designed to protect vulnerable road users when impacted by the vehicle shall be correctly activated before and/or be active during the relevant test.
requirements.test_case: Before and during each impact, check that the pedestrian protection devices (e.g. pedestrian impact sensors and any deployable system they trigger) are correctly activated or active.

requirements.text: The manufacturer shall show that any devices designed to protect vulnerable road users when impacted by the vehicle will act as intended in a pedestrian impact.
requirements.test_case: Review the manufacturer's evidence (sensor triggering tests, simulations) that the pedestrian impact sensors and protective devices act as intended in a pedestrian impact.

requirements.text: For vehicle components which could change shape or position, other than active devices to protect pedestrians, and which have more than one fixed shape or position, the vehicle shall comply with the requirements with the components in each fixed shape or position.
requirements.test_case: Identify movable bumper components (e.g. towing device cover, charging-port flap, grille elements) and test or assess the vehicle with each component in every fixed shape or position.

requirements.text: For each lower legform to bumper test, the flexible lower legform impactor (femur, knee joint and tibia) shall be covered by flesh and skin composed of synthetic rubber sheets (R1, R2) and neoprene sheets (N1F, N2F, N1T, N2T, N3) as shown in Figure 1.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the impactor before each bumper test and confirm the femur, knee joint and tibia are covered by the R1, R2, N1F, N2F, N1T, N2T and N3 sheets arranged as in Figure 1.

requirements.text: For the flexible lower legform impactor, the size of the flesh and skin sheets shall be within the requirements described in Figure 1.
requirements.test_case: Measure each flesh and skin sheet and compare its dimensions with the limits of Figure 1.

requirements.text: For the flexible lower legform impactor, the flesh and skin sheets shall have compression characteristics as shown in Figure 2.
requirements.test_case: Run a compression test on the sheet material and check the force-deflection curve lies within the corridors of Figure 2.

requirements.text: For the flexible lower legform impactor, the compression characteristics shall be checked using material from the same batch as the sheets used for the impactor flesh and skin.
requirements.test_case: Review the compression test record and confirm the tested material carries the same batch number as the sheets fitted to the impactor.

requirements.text: Prior to impactor removal for testing, all flexible lower legform impactor components shall be stored for a sufficient period of time in a controlled storage area with a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 4 °C.
requirements.test_case: Check the storage area temperature log for the period before removal and confirm it stayed within 20 °C ± 4 °C.

requirements.text: After removal from the storage, the flexible lower legform impactor shall not be subjected to conditions other than those pertaining in the test area as defined in Annex 3, paragraph 1.1.
requirements.test_case: Review the test log and confirm the impactor stayed only in the test area conditions of Annex 3, paragraph 1.1 between removal from storage and impact.

requirements.text: For the lower legform to bumper tests, each test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.
requirements.test_case: Compare the recorded time of removal from storage with the time of test completion and confirm it is not more than two hours.

requirements.text: For the lower legform to bumper tests, the selected measuring points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 2.14. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Mark the bumper test area according to paragraph 2.14. on the vehicle and confirm every lower legform measuring point lies within it.

requirements.text: A minimum of three lower legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.test_case: Review the test plan and report and confirm at least three lower legform tests were made, one in the middle third and one in each outer third of the bumper test area, at the positions judged most injurious.

requirements.text: Where the types of structure vary throughout the area to be assessed, the lower legform to bumper tests shall be to different types of structure.
requirements.test_case: Compare the bumper structure drawings with the test points and confirm the lower legform tests cover the different types of structure in the bumper test area.

requirements.text: For the lower legform to bumper tests, the selected test points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral distance between adjacent lower legform test points perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane and confirm each is at least 84 mm.

requirements.text: For the lower legform to bumper tests, the positions tested by the laboratories shall be indicated in the test report.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report and confirm every lower legform test position is indicated.

requirements.text: For the lower legform to bumper tests, the direction of the impact velocity vector shall be in the horizontal plane and parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance for the direction of the velocity vector in the horizontal plane and in the longitudinal plane of ±2° at the time of first contact.
requirements.test_case: Measure the impactor velocity vector at first contact (e.g. with high-speed video) and confirm it is horizontal and parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane within ±2°.

requirements.text: For the lower legform to bumper tests, the axis of the impactor shall be perpendicular to the horizontal plane with a roll and pitch angle tolerance of ±2° in the lateral and longitudinal plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure the roll and pitch angles of the impactor axis at first contact and confirm each is within ±2° of the vertical.

requirements.text: For the lower legform to bumper tests, the bottom of the impactor (without parts needed for the purposes of launching and/or protection) shall be at 75 mm above ground reference plane at the time of first contact with the bumper (see Figure 4), with a ±10 mm tolerance.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the impactor bottom above the ground reference plane at first contact with the bumper and confirm it is 75 mm ± 10 mm.

requirements.text: When setting the height of the propulsion system for the lower legform to bumper tests, an allowance shall be made for the influence of gravity during the period of free flight of the impactor.
requirements.test_case: Review the propulsion set-up calculation and confirm the launch height includes the drop due to gravity over the free-flight period.

requirements.text: The lower legform impactor for the bumper tests shall be in "free flight" at the moment of impact, and may be propelled by any means that can be shown to meet the requirements of the test.
requirements.test_case: Check from high-speed video that the impactor is detached from the propulsion system at the moment of impact.

requirements.text: For the lower legform to bumper tests, the impactor shall be released to free flight at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact of the impactor with the propulsion system during rebound of the impactor.
requirements.test_case: Review high-speed video of the rebound phase and confirm the impactor does not touch the propulsion system before the evaluation interval ends.

requirements.text: For the lower legform to bumper tests, at the time of first contact the impactor shall have the intended orientation about its vertical axis, for the correct operation of its knee joint, with a yaw angle tolerance of ±5° (see Figure 3).
requirements.test_case: Measure the impactor yaw angle at first contact and confirm it is within ±5° of the intended orientation.

requirements.text: For the lower legform testing, a horizontal and vertical impact tolerance of ±10 mm shall apply; the test laboratory may verify at a sufficient number of measuring points that this condition can be met and the tests are thus being conducted with the necessary accuracy.
requirements.test_case: Compare the actual impact point with the target measuring point and confirm the horizontal and vertical deviation is within ±10 mm.

requirements.text: While the impactor is in contact with the vehicle, the impactor shall not contact the ground or any object which is not part of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Review high-speed video of the contact phase and confirm the impactor touches neither the ground nor any object other than the vehicle.

requirements.text: For the lower legform to bumper tests, the impact velocity of the impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.test_case: Measure the impactor velocity at impact with the bumper and confirm it is between 10.9 m/s and 11.3 m/s.

requirements.text: When the impact velocity of the lower legform impactor is obtained from measurements taken before the time of first contact, the effect of gravity shall be taken into account.
requirements.test_case: Review the velocity calculation and confirm it corrects the measured velocity for gravity between the measuring point and first contact.

requirements.text: For the lower legform to bumper tests, the tibia bending moments shall not exceed +/- 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.
requirements.test_case: Read the tibia bending moment channels over the 30 ms before impact and confirm no value exceeds ±15 Nm.

requirements.text: The offset compensation shall be done with the flexible lower legform impactor in resting position prior to the test/acceleration phase.
requirements.test_case: Review the data acquisition log and confirm the zero-offset was taken with the impactor at rest before acceleration started.

requirements.text: For each upper legform to bumper test, the foam flesh shall be two new sheets of 25 mm thick foam type CF-45 or equivalent.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the impactor before each test and confirm two new 25 mm thick sheets of CF-45 foam (or equivalent) are fitted.

requirements.text: For each upper legform to bumper test, the foam flesh sheets shall be cut from the sheet of material used for the dynamic certification test.
requirements.test_case: Compare the foam sheet identification with the dynamic certification record and confirm both come from the same sheet of material.

requirements.text: For the upper legform to bumper test, the skin shall be a 1.5 mm thick fibre reinforced rubber sheet.
requirements.test_case: Measure the skin thickness and check its material and confirm it is a 1.5 mm thick fibre reinforced rubber sheet.

requirements.text: For the upper legform to bumper test, the mass of the foam and the rubber skin together shall be 0.6 kg ± 0.1 kg (this excludes any reinforcement, mountings, etc. which are used to attach the rear edges of the rubber skin to the rear member).
requirements.test_case: Weigh the foam and rubber skin together without the attachment parts and confirm the mass is 0.6 kg ± 0.1 kg.

requirements.text: For the upper legform to bumper test, the foam and rubber skin shall be folded back towards the rear, with the rubber skin attached via spacers to the rear member so that the sides of the rubber skin are held parallel.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the assembled impactor and confirm the foam and skin are folded back and the skin is attached to the rear member via spacers with its sides parallel.

requirements.text: For the upper legform to bumper test, the foam shall be of such a size and shape that an adequate gap is maintained between the foam and components behind the front member, to avoid significant load paths between the foam and these components.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the assembled impactor and confirm there is a gap between the foam and the components behind the front member.

requirements.text: Prior to impactor removal for test, the upper legform test impactor or at least the foam flesh shall be stored during a period of at least four hours in a controlled storage area with a stabilized humidity of 35 per cent ± 15 per cent and a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 4 °C.
requirements.test_case: Check the storage log and confirm at least four hours of storage at 35 % ± 15 % humidity and 20 °C ± 4 °C before removal.

requirements.text: After removal from the storage, the upper legform impactor shall not be subjected to conditions other than those pertaining in the test area.
requirements.test_case: Review the test log and confirm the impactor stayed only in the test area conditions between removal from storage and impact.

requirements.text: For the upper legform to bumper tests, each test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.
requirements.test_case: Compare the recorded time of removal from storage with the time of test completion and confirm it is not more than two hours.

requirements.text: For the upper legform to bumper tests, the selected measuring points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 2.14. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Mark the bumper test area according to paragraph 2.14. on the vehicle and confirm every upper legform measuring point lies within it.

requirements.text: A minimum of three upper legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.test_case: Review the test plan and report and confirm at least three upper legform tests were made, one in the middle third and one in each outer third of the bumper test area, at the positions judged most injurious.

requirements.text: Where the types of structure vary throughout the area to be assessed, the upper legform to bumper tests shall be to different types of structure.
requirements.test_case: Compare the bumper structure drawings with the test points and confirm the upper legform tests cover the different types of structure in the bumper test area.

requirements.text: For the upper legform to bumper tests, the selected measuring points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral distance between adjacent upper legform measuring points perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane and confirm each is at least 84 mm.

requirements.text: For the upper legform to bumper tests, the positions tested by the laboratories shall be indicated in the test report.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report and confirm every upper legform test position is indicated.

requirements.text: For the upper legform to bumper tests, the direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact, with a tolerance to this direction of ±2°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the impact direction and the impactor axis angle at first contact and confirm the direction is parallel to the vehicle longitudinal axis and the axis vertical, each within ±2°.

requirements.text: For the upper legform to bumper tests, at the time of first contact the impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a ±10 mm tolerance.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the impactor centre line at first contact and confirm it is within ±10 mm of the midpoint between the upper and lower bumper reference lines.

requirements.text: For the upper legform to bumper tests, at the time of first contact the impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ±10 mm; the test laboratory may verify at a sufficient number of measuring points that this condition can be met and the tests are thus being conducted with the necessary accuracy.
requirements.test_case: Compare the lateral position of the impactor vertical centre line at first contact with the selected impact location and confirm the deviation is within ±10 mm.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.test_case: Measure the upper legform impactor velocity at impact with the bumper and confirm it is between 10.9 m/s and 11.3 m/s.

requirements.text: For the legform test to bumper, for vehicles with a lower bumper height of less than 425 mm, the requirements of paragraph 4.1.1. shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower bumper height and, if it is less than 425 mm, confirm the lower legform to bumper test of paragraph 4.1.1. is performed.

requirements.text: For the legform test to bumper, for vehicles with a lower bumper height which is greater than, or equal to 425 mm and less than 500 mm, the requirements of either paragraph 4.1.1. or 4.1.2., at the choice of the manufacturer, shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower bumper height and, if it is from 425 mm to below 500 mm, confirm the lower or upper legform test chosen by the manufacturer is performed.

requirements.text: For the legform test to bumper, for vehicles with a lower bumper height of greater than, or equal to, 500 mm, the requirements of paragraph 4.1.2. shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower bumper height and, if it is 500 mm or more, confirm the upper legform to bumper test of paragraph 4.1.2. is performed.

requirements.text: For the lower legform to bumper test, to verify compliance with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.1., both the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.1. and the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.1. shall be used.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report to confirm the lower legform test used the impactor of paragraph 6.3.1.1. and the procedure of paragraph 7.1.1.

requirements.text: For the upper legform to bumper test, to verify compliance with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.2., both the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.2. and the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.2. shall be used.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report to confirm the upper legform test used the impactor of paragraph 6.3.1.2. and the procedure of paragraph 7.1.2.

requirements.text: For the child headform impact, to verify compliance with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.2.1., both the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.2.1. and the test procedures specified in paragraphs 7.2. and 7.3. shall be used.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report to confirm the child headform tests used the impactor of paragraph 6.3.2.1. and the procedures of paragraphs 7.2. and 7.3.

requirements.text: For the adult headform impact, to verify compliance with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.2.2., both the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.2.2. and the test procedures specified in paragraphs 7.2. and 7.4. shall be used.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report to confirm the adult headform tests used the impactor of paragraph 6.3.2.2. and the procedures of paragraphs 7.2. and 7.4.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 22 mm.
requirements.test_case: Perform the flexible lower legform impacts across the bumper test area and confirm the absolute maximum MCL elongation is 22 mm or less at every test point.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the maximum dynamic anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament elongation shall not exceed 13 mm.
requirements.test_case: Perform the flexible lower legform impacts and confirm the maximum ACL and PCL elongations are each 13 mm or less at every test point.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the absolute value of dynamic bending moments at the tibia shall not exceed 340 Nm, except that the manufacturer may nominate bumper test widths up to a maximum of 264 mm in total where the absolute value of the tibia bending moment shall not exceed 380 Nm.
requirements.test_case: Evaluate the tibia bending moments of each flexible lower legform impact and confirm they are 340 Nm or less outside any nominated relaxation widths.

requirements.text: Where the manufacturer nominates bumper test widths up to a maximum of 264 mm in total, the absolute value of the tibia bending moment in the nominated bumper test widths shall not exceed 380 Nm, unless a Contracting Party restricts application of the relaxation zone requirement in its domestic legislation.
requirements.test_case: Check that the nominated relaxation widths total 264 mm or less and that tibia bending moments measured in them are 380 Nm or less, where the Contracting Party allows the relaxation zone.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.2. (upper legform to bumper), the instantaneous sum of the impact forces with respect to time shall not exceed 7.5 kN.
requirements.test_case: Perform the upper legform to bumper test and confirm the instantaneous sum of the impact forces stays at or below 7.5 kN throughout the impact.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.2. (upper legform to bumper), the bending moment on the test impactor shall not exceed 510 Nm.
requirements.test_case: Perform the upper legform to bumper test and confirm the bending moment on the impactor stays at or below 510 Nm.

requirements.text: At the time of testing, the test facility and the vehicle or sub-system shall have a relative humidity of 40 percent ± 30 percent and stabilized temperature of 20 + 4 ºC.
requirements.test_case: Record the relative humidity and stabilized temperature of the facility and the vehicle or bumper sub-system at test time and confirm 40 % ± 30 % and 20 + 4 ºC.

requirements.text: The impact test site shall consist of a flat, smooth and hard surface with a slope not exceeding 1 percent.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the impact test site and measure its slope to confirm a flat, smooth and hard surface with a slope of 1 percent or less.

requirements.text: For the test, either a complete vehicle, or a cut-body, adjusted to the conditions of paragraphs 6.2.1.1. and 6.2.1.2. shall be used.
requirements.test_case: Check that the test object is a complete vehicle or a cut-body prepared according to paragraphs 6.2.1.1. and 6.2.1.2.

requirements.text: For the test, the vehicle shall be in its normal ride attitude.
requirements.test_case: Measure the ride height at the reference marks before the test and confirm the vehicle is in its normal ride attitude.

requirements.text: For the test, the vehicle shall be either securely mounted on raised supports or at rest on a flat horizontal surface with the parking brake applied.
requirements.test_case: Inspect that the vehicle is securely mounted on raised supports or rests on a flat horizontal surface with the parking brake applied.

requirements.text: Where a cut-body is used, the cut-body shall include, in the test, all parts of the vehicle front structure, all under-bonnet components and all components behind the windscreen that may be involved in a frontal impact with a vulnerable road user, to demonstrate the performance and interactions of all the contributory vehicle components.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the cut-body to confirm the complete bumper module (fascia, grille, absorber, lower stiffener, sensors and brackets) and all other front structure and under-bonnet components that may be involved are fitted.

requirements.text: Where a cut-body is used, the cut-body shall be securely mounted in the normal vehicle ride attitude.
requirements.test_case: Check that the cut-body is rigidly mounted and that its reference marks correspond to the normal vehicle ride attitude.

requirements.text: All devices designed to protect vulnerable road users when impacted by the vehicle shall be correctly activated before and/or be active during the relevant test.
requirements.test_case: Verify that pedestrian protection devices, including the pedestrian impact sensors and any deployable system, are activated or active during each test.

requirements.text: The manufacturer shall be responsible for showing that any devices designed to protect vulnerable road users will act as intended in a pedestrian impact.
requirements.test_case: Review the manufacturer's evidence (e.g. sensing and deployment test data) that the pedestrian protection devices act as intended in a pedestrian impact.

requirements.text: Where vehicle components which could change shape or position, other than active devices to protect pedestrians, have more than one fixed shape or position, the vehicle shall comply with the components in each fixed shape or position.
requirements.test_case: Identify components with more than one fixed position (e.g. towing device cover, licence plate holder, charging-port flap) and confirm compliance is shown in each fixed shape or position.

requirements.text: When tested as a DPPS, the vehicle shall be adjusted as specified in the test procedure defined in Annex 1.
requirements.test_case: Where a DPPS is fitted, check that the vehicle was adjusted according to the Annex 1 test procedure before the tests.

requirements.text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, each test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.
requirements.test_case: Compare the storage removal time with the test completion time in the test log and confirm less than two hours.

requirements.text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, the selected target points shall be in the bumper test area.
requirements.test_case: Mark the bumper test area on the vehicle and confirm each selected lower legform target point lies within it.

requirements.text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, the direction of the impact velocity vector shall be in the horizontal plane and parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the impactor trajectory before contact and confirm it is horizontal and parallel to the vehicle longitudinal vertical plane.

requirements.text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, the tolerance for the direction of the velocity vector in the horizontal plane and in the longitudinal plane shall be ± 2° at the time of first contact.
requirements.test_case: Evaluate the velocity vector direction at first contact from high-speed video and confirm deviations within ± 2° in both planes.

requirements.text: For the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test, the axis of the impactor shall be perpendicular to the horizontal plane, with a roll and pitch angle tolerance of ± 2° in the lateral and longitudinal plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure the impactor roll and pitch angles at first contact and confirm each is within ± 2° of vertical.

requirements.text: At the time of the first contact with the bumper, the bottom of the flexible lower legform impactor (without parts needed for the purposes of launching and/or protection) shall be 75 mm above the ground reference plane (see Figure 21), with a tolerance of ± 10 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the impactor bottom above the ground reference plane at first contact and confirm 75 ± 10 mm.

requirements.text: When setting the height of the propulsion system, an allowance shall be made for the influence of gravity during the period of free flight of the impactor.
requirements.test_case: Check the launcher height setting calculation and confirm it compensates for the gravity drop during free flight.

requirements.text: The lower legform impactor for the bumper tests shall be in 'free flight' at the moment of impact, whereby the impactor may be propelled by any means that can be shown to meet the requirements of the test.
requirements.test_case: Review high-speed video and confirm the impactor is detached from the propulsion system at the moment of impact.

requirements.text: The lower legform impactor shall be released to free flight at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact of the impactor with the propulsion system during the rebound of the impactor.
requirements.test_case: Review high-speed video of the rebound and confirm the impactor does not contact the propulsion system before the end of the measurement.

requirements.text: At the time of first contact, the flexible lower legform impactor shall have the intended orientation about its vertical axis, for the correct operation of its knee joint, with a yaw angle tolerance of ± 5° (see Figure 20).
requirements.test_case: Measure the impactor yaw angle at first contact and confirm it is within ± 5° of the intended orientation.

requirements.text: At the time of first contact, the centre line of the flexible lower legform impactor shall be within a ± 10 mm tolerance to the selected impact location.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral position of the impactor centre line at first contact and confirm it is within ± 10 mm of the selected impact location.

requirements.text: While the flexible lower legform impactor is in contact with the vehicle, the impactor shall not contact the ground or any object which is not part of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Review high-speed video of the impact and confirm the impactor touches nothing but the vehicle during contact.

requirements.text: When striking the bumper, the impact velocity of the flexible lower legform impactor shall be 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.test_case: Measure the impactor velocity at first contact with the bumper and confirm 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.

requirements.text: When the impact velocity is obtained from measurements taken before the time of first contact, the effect of gravity shall be taken into account.
requirements.test_case: Check the velocity evaluation and confirm the gravity correction is applied when the speed is measured before first contact.

requirements.text: The tibia bending moments of the flexible lower legform impactor shall not exceed ± 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.
requirements.test_case: Evaluate the tibia bending moment channels over the 30 ms before impact and confirm all values are within ± 15 Nm.

requirements.text: The offset compensation shall be done with the flexible lower legform impactor in resting position prior to the test / acceleration phase.
requirements.test_case: Check the test procedure record and confirm the transducer offsets were zeroed with the impactor at rest before acceleration.

requirements.text: For the upper legform to bumper test, each test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.
requirements.test_case: Compare the storage removal time with the test completion time in the test log and confirm less than two hours.

requirements.text: For the upper legform to bumper test, the selected target points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 3.10.
requirements.test_case: Mark the bumper test area per paragraph 3.10 on the vehicle and confirm each selected upper legform target point lies within it.

requirements.text: For the upper legform to bumper test, the direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact, with a tolerance to this direction of ± 2°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the impact direction and impactor axis angle at first contact and confirm both are within ± 2°.

requirements.text: At the time of first contact, the upper legform impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a + 10 mm tolerance.
requirements.test_case: Measure the upper and lower bumper reference lines and the impactor centre line height at first contact and confirm it is midway within + 10 mm.

requirements.text: At the time of first contact, the upper legform impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ± 10 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral position of the impactor vertical centre line at first contact and confirm it is within ± 10 mm of the selected impact location.

requirements.text: When striking the bumper, the impact velocity of the upper legform impactor shall be 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.test_case: Measure the upper legform velocity at first contact with the bumper and confirm 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.

requirements.text: The Contracting Party shall assign an approval number to each type approved.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval communication for an assigned approval number for the vehicle type.

requirements.text: The first two digits of the approval number shall indicate the series of amendments incorporating the most recent major technical amendments made to the Regulation at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Compare the first two digits of the approval number with the series of amendments in force at the date of issue.

requirements.text: The same Contracting Party shall not assign the same approval number to another vehicle type.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval register of the Contracting Party to confirm the number is unique to this vehicle type.

requirements.text: Every vehicle conforming to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation shall have affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, an international approval mark consisting of the elements specified in paragraphs 5.4.1. and 5.4.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect a production vehicle to confirm the approval mark is affixed conspicuously at the readily accessible place named on the approval form.

requirements.text: The international approval mark shall include a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark for a circle around the letter E followed by the correct country number.

requirements.text: The international approval mark shall include the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle prescribed in paragraph 5.4.1.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark for "42R-" followed by the approval number to the right of the circle.

requirements.text: Where the vehicle conforms to a vehicle type approved under one or more other Regulations annexed to the Agreement in the country which has granted approval under this Regulation, the Regulation and approval numbers and the additional symbols of all the Regulations under which approval has been granted in the country which has granted approval under this Regulation shall be placed in vertical columns to the right of the symbol prescribed in paragraph 5.4.1., except that the symbol prescribed in paragraph 5.4.1. need not be repeated.
requirements.test_case: Inspect a combined approval mark to confirm the Regulation and approval numbers are arranged in vertical columns to the right of the single circle symbol.

requirements.text: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and be indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visually check legibility of the approval mark and perform a rub/solvent durability check to confirm it is indelible.

requirements.text: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle to confirm the approval mark is on or adjacent to the manufacturer's data plate.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle shall meet the requirements of paragraphs 6.1.1. to 6.1.5.
requirements.test_case: After each Annex 3 impact, inspect and function-check the vehicle against paragraphs 6.1.1. to 6.1.5.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the lighting and signalling devices shall continue to operate correctly, except that should the adjustment of the factory-fitted lighting devices be disturbed, it may be corrected to conform to the required specifications, provided this can be done by the normal means of adjustment, and bulbs may be replaced in the event of filament failure.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, switch on every lighting and signalling function, including the bumper side signalling lamp, and confirm correct operation.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the lighting and signalling devices shall remain visible.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, inspect the lighting and signalling devices, including lamps integrated in the bumper, to confirm they are not obscured by displaced or deformed bumper parts.

requirements.text: If the adjustment of the factory-fitted lighting devices is disturbed by an impact test made in accordance with annex 3 to this Regulation, then the factory-fitted lighting devices shall be correctable to conform to the required specifications by the normal means of adjustment.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, measure lamp aim and, where disturbed, confirm it can be restored to specification using only the normal adjustment means.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's bonnet (hood), boot lid (trunk lid) and doors shall be operable in the normal manner.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, open and close the bonnet, boot lid and every door using the normal controls and confirm normal operation.

requirements.text: For each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the side doors of the vehicle shall not be able to open under the effect of the impact.
requirements.test_case: Monitor the side doors during each impact (high-speed video or inspection) and confirm none opens.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's fuel and cooling systems shall have neither leaks nor constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, inspect the fuel and cooling systems for leaks and run the system to confirm no constricted passages impair function.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the sealing devices and caps of the vehicle's fuel and cooling systems shall be operable in the normal manner.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, open and close the filler caps, sealing devices and the EV charging-port flap and confirm normal operation.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's exhaust system shall not suffer any damage or displacement which would prevent its normal function.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, inspect the exhaust system for damage or displacement and confirm normal function.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall remain in adjustment, except that this requirement does not apply to sensors, cameras, radar devices, etc. being part of driver assist systems, which may become damaged, disoriented or broken due to an impact carried out according to Annex 3 as long as the basic braking and steering performance are still intact.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, measure wheel alignment and check the adjustment of propulsion, suspension, steering and braking systems against specification.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall operate in a normal manner, except that this requirement does not apply to sensors, cameras, radar devices, etc. being part of driver assist systems, which may become damaged, disoriented or broken due to an impact carried out according to Annex 3 as long as the basic braking and steering performance are still intact.
requirements.test_case: After each impact, perform a functional drive check of propulsion, steering and braking to confirm normal operation.

requirements.text: Where sensors, cameras, radar devices, etc. being part of driver assist systems become damaged, disoriented or broken due to an impact carried out according to Annex 3, the basic braking and steering performance shall still be intact.
requirements.test_case: After each impact that damages or misaligns the bumper radar, camera or PDC sensors, verify basic braking and steering performance by a functional test.

requirements.text: When the vehicle type is modified, the manufacturer shall notify every modification of the vehicle type to the administrative department which approved the vehicle type.
requirements.test_case: Check the change management records for notification of bumper or structure modifications to the approving administrative department.

requirements.text: For the low-speed-impact test, the vehicle shall be placed on a horizontal and level rigid smooth surface.
requirements.test_case: Verify in the test report that the test surface was horizontal, level, rigid and smooth.

requirements.text: For the low-speed-impact test, the vehicle shall be at rest.
requirements.test_case: Verify in the test report that the vehicle was stationary at the moment of impact.

requirements.text: For the low-speed-impact test, the front wheels shall be in the straight-ahead position.
requirements.test_case: Verify before each impact that the front wheels are in the straight-ahead position.

requirements.text: For the low-speed-impact test, the tyres shall be inflated to the pressure recommended by the vehicle manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Measure tyre pressures before each impact and compare with the manufacturer's recommended values.

requirements.text: For the low-speed-impact test, the brakes shall be disengaged.
requirements.test_case: Verify before each impact that the service and parking brakes are released.

requirements.text: For the low-speed-impact test, the transmission control shall be in neutral position.
requirements.test_case: Verify before each impact that the transmission control is in neutral.

requirements.text: Where vehicles are equipped with hydro pneumatic, hydraulic or pneumatic suspension or a device for automatic levelling according to load, the vehicles shall be tested in the normal running conditions specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the suspension or levelling system is set to the manufacturer's normal running condition before measuring bumper height and impacting.

requirements.text: The impactor shall be of rigid construction, the impact contour being of hardened steel.
requirements.test_case: Check the impactor certificate for rigid construction and a hardened steel impact contour.

requirements.text: The impacting surface shall conform to the diagram in the figure.
requirements.test_case: Measure the impactor contour and compare it with the figure of Annex 3.

requirements.text: For the impactor (striker), the effective mass shall be equal to the mass corresponding to the "unladen weight" of the vehicle to be tested.
requirements.test_case: Weigh the vehicle at unladen weight and confirm the impactor effective mass equals it.

requirements.text: While plane A of the impactor is vertical, the reference line shall be horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Measure the impactor orientation with plane A vertical and confirm the reference line is horizontal.

requirements.text: The first contact of the impactor with the vehicle shall be by the impact contour on the protective device.
requirements.test_case: Check by high-speed video or contact marks that the impactor first touches the bumper protective device with its impact contour and no other vehicle part first.

requirements.text: For the two vehicle-loading conditions, the protective device between the corners, as defined in paragraph 3.1.5. of this Regulation, shall be intersected by the horizontal plane passing through the reference line.
requirements.test_case: Measure the bumper height profile between the vehicle corners at unladen weight and laden test weight and confirm the 445 mm horizontal plane intersects the protective device across the full width.

requirements.text: The reference height shall be 445 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the impactor reference line above the ground and confirm it is 445 mm.

requirements.text: Where the impactor is secured to a carriage (moving barrier) by a restraining element, the restraining element shall be rigid and be incapable of being deformed by the impact.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the restraining element after the impact for absence of deformation.

requirements.text: Where the impactor is secured to a carriage (moving barrier) by a restraining element, the carriage shall at the moment of impact be capable of moving freely and no longer be subject to the action of the propelling device.
requirements.test_case: Verify from the test set-up records that the propelling device was disengaged before impact and the carriage moved freely.

requirements.text: Where a pendulum is used, the distance between the pivot and the centre of percussion shall be at least 3.3 m.
requirements.test_case: Measure the pivot to centre-of-percussion distance of the pendulum and confirm it is at least 3.3 m.

requirements.text: Where a pendulum is used, the reference line shall coincide with the centre of percussion.
requirements.test_case: Verify by measurement that the impactor reference line lies at the pendulum centre of percussion.

requirements.text: Where a pendulum is used, plane A of the pendulum shall remain parallel with the axis of rotation of the pendulum throughout the test.
requirements.test_case: Check by measurement or video that plane A stays parallel to the pendulum axis of rotation during the swing.

requirements.text: In the case of a parallelogram-suspended pendulum, the trajectory described by any point on the reference line shall be constant with a radius of at least 3.3 m.
requirements.test_case: Measure the trajectory radius of a reference-line point on the parallelogram pendulum and confirm it is constant and at least 3.3 m.

requirements.text: The longitudinal impact test shall consist of two impacts on the front surface and two impacts on the rear surface of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report for two front-surface and two rear-surface longitudinal impacts.

requirements.text: For the longitudinal impact test, on each surface one impact shall be made with the vehicle under "unladen weight", as defined in paragraph 3.1.3. of this Regulation, and the other with the vehicle under "laden test weight", as defined in paragraph 3.1.4.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report that on the front surface one impact was made at unladen weight and one at laden test weight, with vehicle mass recorded.

requirements.text: For the impacts on the front and rear surfaces, the choice of location of the impactor for the first impact being free, the median plane of the impactor for the second impact shall be at a distance at least 300 mm from the first, provided that during these impacts the extremities of the impactor do not pass outside a zone defined by two planes parallel to the longitudinal median plane and passing through the corners of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral positions of the impactor median plane for the two front impacts and confirm they are at least 300 mm apart.

requirements.text: During the impacts on the front and rear surfaces, the extremities of the impactor shall not pass outside a zone defined by two planes parallel to the longitudinal median plane and passing through the corners of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Mark the vehicle corners per paragraph 3.1.5. and confirm the impactor ends stay within the planes through the corners for each longitudinal impact.

requirements.text: For the longitudinal impact test, the impactor shown in the figure shall be placed so that plane A is vertical and the reference line is horizontal at the reference height of 445 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure impactor plane A verticality and reference line height (445 mm) before each longitudinal impact.

requirements.text: For the longitudinal impact test, the vehicle shall be aligned so that a point between the vehicle corners touches, but does not move, the impactor, the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle being perpendicular to plane A of the impactor.
requirements.test_case: Verify before each longitudinal impact that the bumper touches the impactor between the corners without moving it and that the vehicle median plane is perpendicular to plane A.

requirements.text: For the longitudinal impact test, the vehicle shall be impacted at a speed of 4 km/h +0.25/-0.
requirements.test_case: Record the impact speed of each longitudinal impact and confirm it is between 4.00 and 4.25 km/h.

requirements.text: The corner impact test shall consist of an impact at one front corner and an impact at one rear corner of the vehicle, which is at unladen weight (see paragraph 3.1.3. of the Regulation), and an impact at the other front corner and the other rear corner with the vehicle at the weight given in paragraph 3.1.4.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report that one front corner was impacted at unladen weight and the other front corner at laden test weight (and likewise at the rear).

requirements.text: For the corner impact test, the impactor shown in the figure shall be placed so that plane A is vertical and the reference line is horizontal and at the reference height of 445 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure impactor plane A verticality and reference line height (445 mm) before each corner impact.

requirements.text: For the corner impact test, the vehicle shall be aligned so that a corner of the vehicle touches the impactor without moving the impactor.
requirements.test_case: Verify before each corner impact that the bumper corner touches the impactor without displacing it.

requirements.text: For the corner impact test, plane A of the impactor shall make an angle of 60 ± 5º with the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the angle between impactor plane A and the vehicle longitudinal median plane and confirm 60 ± 5°.

requirements.text: For the corner impact test, the point of the first contact shall be in the vertical median plane of the impactor (within a tolerance of ± 25 mm).
requirements.test_case: Measure the offset of the first contact point on the bumper corner from the impactor vertical median plane and confirm it is within ± 25 mm.

requirements.text: For the corner impact test, the vehicle shall be impacted at a speed of 2.5 km/h +0.1/-0.
requirements.test_case: Record the impact speed of each corner impact and confirm it is between 2.5 and 2.6 km/h.

requirements.text: Between the tests, the protective devices and the mountings attaching the protective devices to the vehicle structure shall be permitted to be repaired or replaced.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report for any bumper or mounting repair or replacement between impacts and confirm it was done only between tests.

requirements.text: Where the protective devices include self-restoring materials, the permitted recovery time between tests shall be as stated by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Compare the time between impacts recorded in the test report with the recovery time stated by the manufacturer for the self-restoring absorber material.

requirements.text: When the manufacturer so requests, a vehicle of the same type shall be permitted to be used for each test.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report that any additional test vehicles used at the manufacturer's request are of the same type.

requirements.text: When the manufacturer so requests, the technical service responsible for conducting the tests shall be permitted to allow the same vehicle as is used for tests prescribed by other Regulations (including tests capable of affecting its structure) to be used also for the tests prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report for the manufacturer's request and the technical service's agreement when a vehicle from other Regulation tests is reused.

requirements.text: When the test has been carried out at an impact speed or with an impact mass exceeding those indicated in paragraphs 2.7.5. and 2.8.4., and the vehicle has satisfied the conditions prescribed, the test shall be considered satisfactory.
requirements.test_case: Where recorded impact speed or mass exceeds the nominal values, confirm the vehicle still met paragraph 6 and the test is accepted.

requirements.text: The instrument used to record the speed referred to in paragraphs 2.7.5. and 2.8.4. shall be accurate to within one per cent.
requirements.test_case: Check the calibration certificate of the impact speed measuring instrument for an accuracy within 1 per cent.

requirements.text: Where other equivalent test methods are used, the conditions referred to in this Regulation shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Review any alternative test method to confirm it reproduces the impact conditions of this Regulation.

requirements.text: Where other equivalent test methods are used, the equivalence of the other test methods shall be demonstrated.
requirements.test_case: Review the equivalence demonstration (e.g. correlation data) supplied for any alternative test method.

requirements.text: The provisions of this Regulation shall not apply to those parts of the external surface which, with the vehicle in the laden condition, with all doors, windows and access lids etc., in the closed position, are at a height of more than 2 metres.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of each bumper part with the vehicle laden and all doors, windows and lids closed, and confirm that only parts higher than 2 m are excluded from the assessment.

requirements.text: The provisions of this Regulation shall not apply to those parts of the external surface which, with the vehicle in the laden condition, with all doors, windows and access lids etc., in the closed position, are below the floor line.
requirements.test_case: Determine the floor line on the laden vehicle with all doors, windows and lids closed and confirm that only bumper parts below it (e.g. the lower stiffener) are excluded from the assessment.

requirements.text: The provisions of this Regulation shall not apply to those parts of the external surface which, with the vehicle in the laden condition, with all doors, windows and access lids etc., in the closed position, are so located that, in their static condition as well as when in operation, they cannot be contacted by a sphere 100 mm in diameter.
requirements.test_case: Sweep a 100 mm diameter sphere over the bumper, grille openings and sensor recesses in static and operating condition and confirm that only parts the sphere cannot contact are excluded.

requirements.text: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed bumper module (fascia, grille, sensors, lamps, covers, plate holder) for outward-directed pointed, sharp or hazardous projections.

requirements.text: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed bumper module, including openings, covers and flaps, for any outward-directed part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.

requirements.text: No protruding part of the external surface shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm, except that this requirement shall not apply to parts of the external surface which protrude less than 5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the projection and radii of curvature of all protruding bumper parts with radius gauges per Annex 3 and confirm every part protruding 5 mm or more has radii of at least 2.5 mm.

requirements.text: Where parts of the external surface protrude less than 5 mm, the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure parts protruding between 1.5 mm and 5 mm and visually and tactilely check that their outward facing angles are blunted.

requirements.text: Protruding parts of the external surface, made of a material of hardness not exceeding 60 shore A, shall be permitted to have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.
requirements.test_case: For any protruding part with a radius below 2.5 mm, measure its material hardness and confirm it does not exceed 60 Shore A.

requirements.text: The hardness measurement shall be taken with the component as installed on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report shows the Shore A hardness measured on the component in its installed position on the vehicle.

requirements.text: Where it is impossible to carry out a hardness measurement by the Shore A procedure, comparable measurements shall be used for evaluation.
requirements.test_case: Where Shore A measurement is not feasible on the installed part, confirm a comparable hardness measurement method was used and documented.

requirements.text: The provisions of paragraphs 5.1. to 5.5. shall apply in addition to the particular specifications of paragraph 6., except where these particular specifications expressly provide otherwise.
requirements.test_case: Review the assessment and confirm each bumper part checked against paragraph 6. was also checked against paragraphs 5.1. to 5.5. unless paragraph 6. expressly exempts it.

requirements.text: Added ornaments which project more than 10 mm from their support shall retract, become detached or bend over under a force of 10 daN exerted at their most salient point in any direction in a plane approximately parallel to the surface on which they are mounted, except that these provisions shall not apply to ornaments on radiator grilles.
requirements.test_case: Apply 10 daN at the most salient point of each added ornament projecting more than 10 mm, in directions parallel to its mounting surface, and confirm it retracts, detaches or bends over.

requirements.text: Where ornaments are mounted on radiator grilles, only the general requirements of paragraph 5. shall apply to the ornaments on radiator grilles.
requirements.test_case: Check grille ornaments and badges against the general requirements of paragraphs 5.2. to 5.5. (radii, projections, no sharp parts).

requirements.text: To apply the 10 daN force, a flat-ended ram of not more than 50 mm diameter shall be used, except that where this is not possible, an equivalent method shall be used.
requirements.test_case: Check the ornament test set-up uses a flat-ended ram of not more than 50 mm diameter, or a documented equivalent method where the ram cannot be used.

requirements.text: When the ornaments are retracted, detached or bent over, the remaining projections shall not project more than 10 mm.
requirements.test_case: After the 10 daN test, measure the remaining projection of each ornament and confirm it is not more than 10 mm.

requirements.text: The remaining projections of the retracted, detached or bent over ornaments shall in any case satisfy the provisions of paragraph 5.2.
requirements.test_case: After the 10 daN test, inspect the remaining projections for pointed or sharp parts according to paragraph 5.2.

requirements.text: Where the ornament is mounted on a base, the base shall be regarded as belonging to the ornament and not to the supporting surface.
requirements.test_case: For ornaments on a base, confirm the projection is measured from the supporting surface including the base.

requirements.text: Protective strips or shielding on the external surface shall be firmly secured to the vehicle, except that protective strips or shielding shall not be subject to the requirements of paragraph 6.1.1.
requirements.test_case: Check by pull and inspection that protective strips and shielding on the bumper are firmly secured to the vehicle.

requirements.text: Where the requirements of paragraph 5.4. are not applied to gaps between fixed or movable elements, including those forming part of air intake or outlet grilles and radiator grilles, the distance between consecutive elements shall not exceed 40 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance between consecutive grille and air intake elements per paragraph 4. of Annex 3 and confirm it does not exceed 40 mm where the 5.4. exemption is used.

requirements.text: Where the requirements of paragraph 5.4. are not applied to gaps between fixed or movable elements, including those forming part of air intake or outlet grilles and radiator grilles, the grilles and gaps shall have a functional purpose.
requirements.test_case: Review the design documentation to confirm each exempted grille or gap has a functional purpose (e.g. cooling airflow).

requirements.text: For gaps of between 40 mm and 25 mm, the radii of curvature shall be 1 mm or more.
requirements.test_case: For gaps measured between 25 mm and 40 mm, measure the element radii of curvature and confirm they are 1 mm or more.

requirements.text: Where the distance between two consecutive elements is equal to or less than 25 mm, the radii of curvature of external faces of the elements shall not be less than 0.5 mm.
requirements.test_case: For gaps of 25 mm or less, measure the radii of curvature of the external faces of the elements and confirm they are not less than 0.5 mm.

requirements.text: The distance between two consecutive elements of grilles and gaps shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 4. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the gap measurement report applies the method of paragraph 4. of Annex 3.

requirements.text: The junction of the front with the side faces of each element forming a grille or gap shall be blunted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each grille bar and gap element and confirm the junction of its front face with its side faces is blunted.

requirements.text: The ends of the bumpers shall be turned in towards the external surface in order to minimize the risk of fouling.
requirements.test_case: Inspect both bumper ends and confirm they are turned in towards the external surface.

requirements.text: The requirement that the ends of the bumpers shall be turned in towards the external surface shall be considered to be satisfied if either the bumper is recessed or integrated within the bodywork or the end of the bumper is turned in so that it is not contactable by a 100 mm sphere and the gap between the bumper end and the surrounding bodywork does not exceed 20 mm.
requirements.test_case: Check that the bumper is recessed or integrated in the bodywork, or that a 100 mm sphere cannot contact the bumper end and the measured gap to the surrounding bodywork is not more than 20 mm.

requirements.text: Where the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all its points lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward, and a minimum radius of curvature of 2.5 mm in all other cases.
requirements.test_case: Where the bumper contour line lies on a rigid surface, measure the radii of curvature from the contour line to 20 mm inward (at least 5 mm) and elsewhere (at least 2.5 mm).

requirements.text: The minimum radius of curvature requirement for the line of the bumper on a rigid surface shall apply to that part of the zone lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward which is situated between and in front (or rear in case of the rear bumper) of tangential points with the contour line of two vertical planes each forming with the longitudinal plane of symmetry of the vehicle an angle of 15° (see Fig. 1).
requirements.test_case: Mark the tangential points of the two vertical planes at 15° to the longitudinal plane of symmetry on the bumper contour and confirm the radius check covers the zone between and in front of them.

requirements.text: The requirement of paragraph 6.5.2. shall not apply to parts on or of the bumper or to bumper insets which have a projection of less than 5 mm, with special reference to joint covers and jets for headlamp washers.
requirements.test_case: Measure the projection of bumper insets, joint covers and washer jets and confirm only those projecting less than 5 mm are excluded from the 6.5.2. check.

requirements.text: Where parts on or of the bumper or bumper insets have a projection of less than 5 mm, with special reference to joint covers and jets for headlamp washers, the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
requirements.test_case: For bumper parts and insets protruding between 1.5 mm and 5 mm, inspect and confirm their outward facing angles are blunted.

requirements.text: The provisions of paragraph 5. of this Regulation shall remain applicable to the bumper cover, except that the requirement of paragraph 6.5.2. does not apply to the bumper cover.
requirements.test_case: Check the painted bumper cover (fascia) against paragraphs 5.1. to 5.5. (radii, projections, no sharp or catching parts).

requirements.text: The projection of door or luggage compartment handles shall not exceed 40 mm.
