requirements.test_case: Measure the projection of any door or luggage compartment handle per Annex 3 and confirm it does not exceed 40 mm.

requirements.text: The projection of handles, hinges and push-buttons of doors, luggage compartments and bonnets, and of fuel tank filler caps and covers, shall not exceed 30 mm in all cases other than door or luggage compartment handles.
requirements.test_case: Measure the projection of the EV charging-port flap and any other hinge, push-button or filler cover on the bumper per Annex 3 and confirm it does not exceed 30 mm.

requirements.text: Sheet-metal edges, such as gutter edges and the rails of sliding doors, shall not be permitted unless they are folded back or are fitted with a shield meeting the requirements of this Regulation which are applicable to it.
requirements.test_case: Inspect any exposed sheet-metal edges of the bumper (e.g. the metal lower stiffener) and confirm they are folded back or shielded.

requirements.text: An unprotected edge shall be considered to be folded back either if it is folded back by approximately 180º, or if it is folded towards the bodywork in such a manner that it cannot be contacted by a sphere having a diameter of 100 mm.
requirements.test_case: For each unshielded sheet-metal edge, check it is folded back by approximately 180° or that a 100 mm diameter sphere cannot contact it.

requirements.text: Where folds in body panels have a radius of curvature of less than 2.5 mm, the radius of curvature shall not be less than one-tenth of the height "H" of the projection, measured in accordance with the method described in paragraph 1. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: For any fold or character line in the fascia with a radius below 2.5 mm, measure the height H per paragraph 1. of Annex 3 and confirm the radius is at least H/10.

requirements.text: Air intake and outlet flaps shall meet the requirements of paragraphs 5.2., 5.3. and 5.4. in all positions of use.
requirements.test_case: Move the air intake and outlet flaps (e.g. grille shutters) through all positions of use and check radii, projections and catching parts against paragraphs 5.2. to 5.4. in each position.

requirements.text: Where supporting brackets provided by the vehicle manufacturer for registration plates are contactable by a 100 mm diameter sphere when a registration plate is fitted in accordance with the vehicle manufacturer's recommendation, the supporting brackets shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 5.4. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Fit a registration plate to the licence plate holder as recommended, sweep a 100 mm sphere over the holder and measure the radii of all contactable parts against paragraph 5.4.

requirements.text: Where the unattached end of radio receiving and transmitting aerials is less than 2 m from the road surface in any position of use specified by the manufacturer of the aerial, the radio receiving and transmitting aerials shall be fitted to the vehicle in such a way that the unattached end is inside the zone bounded by the vertical planes which are 10 cm inside the extreme outer edge of the vehicle as defined in paragraph 2.7. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure the position of the keyless-entry aerial's unattached end in every position of use and confirm it lies at least 10 cm inside the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: Aerials shall be so fitted to the vehicle, and if necessary their unattached ends so restricted, that no part of the aerials protrude beyond the extreme outer edge of the vehicle as defined in paragraph 2.7. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check on the vehicle that no part of the aerial protrudes beyond the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The shafts of aerials shall be permitted to have radii of curvature of less than 2.5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Where an aerial shaft has radii below 2.5 mm, confirm the rest of the aerial, including its unattached end, meets the radius requirements.

requirements.text: The unattached ends of aerials shall be fitted with fixed cappings, the radii of curvature of which are not less than 2.5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the aerial's unattached end for a fixed capping and measure its radii of curvature to be not less than 2.5 mm.

requirements.text: The bases of aerials shall not project more than 40 mm when determined according to the procedure of paragraph 2. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure the projection of the aerial base per paragraph 2. of Annex 3 and confirm it is not more than 40 mm.

requirements.text: Where by the absence of a flexible shaft or part it is not possible to identify what the base is of an aerial, the requirement of paragraph 6.17.4. shall be deemed to be met if, after a horizontal force of not more than 50 daN in forward and rearward direction is applied by a flat-ended ram of not more than 50 mm diameter at the most salient part of the aerial, either (a) the aerial bends towards the support and does not project more than 40 mm, or (b) the aerial breaks off and the remaining part of the aerial does not show any sharp or dangerous part that can be contacted by the 100 mm sphere and does not project more than 40 mm.
requirements.test_case: Apply up to 50 daN forwards and rearwards with a flat-ended ram of not more than 50 mm diameter at the most salient part of the aerial and confirm it bends or breaks off leaving no more than 40 mm projection and no sharp part contactable by the 100 mm sphere.

requirements.text: Where aerials are located behind the vertical transversal plane passing through the "R" point of the driver, paragraphs 6.17.4. and 6.17.4.1. shall not apply, provided that the maximum projection of the aerial including its housing does not exceed 70 mm when determined according to the procedure of paragraph 2. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Determine the aerial position relative to the driver's R point and, if behind it, measure the projection of aerial and housing per paragraph 2. of Annex 3 to be not more than 70 mm.

requirements.text: If the aerial is located behind the vertical transversal plane passing through the "R" point of the driver but projects more than 70 mm, then paragraph 6.17.4.1. shall apply using a projection limit of 70 mm instead of 40 mm.
requirements.test_case: For an aerial behind the R point projecting more than 70 mm, perform the 6.17.4.1. ram test and confirm the remaining projection is not more than 70 mm.

requirements.text: The height H of a projection shall be determined graphically by reference to the circumference of a 165 mm diameter circle, internally tangential to the external outline of the external surface at the section to be checked.
requirements.test_case: On the section drawings or the physical fascia, check that the height H of each fold projection is determined with a 165 mm diameter circle internally tangential to the external outline at the checked section.

requirements.text: The height H of a projection shall be the maximum value of the distance, measured along a straight line passing through the centre of the 165 mm diameter circle, between the circumference of the aforesaid circle and the external contour of the projection (see Fig.1).
requirements.test_case: Verify that the reported H is the largest distance, along a line through the centre of the 165 mm circle, between the circle circumference and the external contour of the projection, as in Fig. 1.

requirements.text: Where it is not possible for a 100 mm diameter circle to contact externally part of the external outline of the external surface at the section under consideration, the surface outline in this area shall be assumed to be that formed by the circumference of the 100 mm diameter circle between its tangent points with the external outline (see Fig.2).
requirements.test_case: At sections where a 100 mm diameter circle cannot touch the outline externally, check that the outline used for the H measurement is the arc of the 100 mm circle between its tangent points, as in Fig. 2.

requirements.text: The manufacturer shall provide drawings of the necessary sections through the external surface to allow the height of the projections referred to in paragraphs 1.1. to 1.3. of Annex 3 to be measured.
requirements.test_case: Check that the approval documentation contains section drawings through the bumper external surface sufficient to measure the height H of every fold projection.

requirements.text: The dimension of the projection of a component which is mounted on a convex surface shall be determined either directly or by reference to a drawing of an appropriate section of this component in its installed condition.
requirements.test_case: For each component mounted on a convex part of the fascia (e.g. PDC sensors, towing device cover, licence plate holder), verify the projection is measured directly on the part or from a section drawing of the component in its installed condition.

requirements.text: If the dimension of the projection of a component which is mounted on a surface other than convex cannot be determined by simple measurement, then the dimension of the projection shall be determined by the maximum variation of the distance of the centre of a 100 mm diameter sphere from the nominal line of the panel when the sphere is moved over and is in constant contact with that component.
requirements.test_case: For components on non-convex surfaces that cannot be measured simply, move a 100 mm diameter sphere over the component in constant contact and record the maximum variation of the sphere centre from the nominal panel line as the projection.

requirements.text: For headlamp visors and rims, the projection from the external surface of the headlamp shall be measured horizontally from the point of contact of a 100 mm diameter sphere as shown in Figure 4.
requirements.test_case: Where a headlamp visor or rim is present in the bumper, measure its projection horizontally from the contact point of a 100 mm diameter sphere on the headlamp external surface, as in Figure 4.

requirements.text: The dimension of a gap or space between elements of a grille shall be determined by the distance between two planes passing through the points of contact of the sphere and perpendicular to the line joining those points of contact.
requirements.test_case: Place the sphere between consecutive grille bars and measure the distance between the two planes through the contact points perpendicular to the line joining them, as in Figures 5 and 6.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which the lighting and light-signalling devices may be subjected, the lighting and light-signalling devices retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Subject the bumper with its installed lamps to the vehicle vibration profile and verify that photometric, colorimetric and positional characteristics remain within the prescribed values afterwards.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which the lighting and light-signalling devices may be subjected, the lighting and light-signalling devices enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: After vibration exposure, check on the vehicle that the bumper-mounted lamps still meet all R48 installation requirements (position, visibility, orientation).

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall prevent the lamps from being inadvertently maladjusted under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which the lighting and light-signalling devices may be subjected.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp mounting in the bumper and measure the lamp orientation before and after vibration and handling loads to confirm it cannot shift inadvertently.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3° allowed in each direction.
requirements.test_case: Measure the angle between the reference axis of each installed signalling lamp and the road bearing plane and confirm it is within ±3°.

requirements.text: For side retro-reflectors and side-marker lamps, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3° allowed in each direction.
requirements.test_case: Measure the angle of the reference axis of the bumper side-marker lamp to the vehicle median longitudinal plane and confirm it is 90° ±3°.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices other than side retro-reflectors and side-marker lamps, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3° allowed in each direction.
requirements.test_case: Measure the angle between the reference axis of each other installed signalling lamp (e.g. direction indicator) and the median longitudinal plane and confirm it is within ±3°.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Compare the installation of each signalling lamp in the bumper with the manufacturer's fitting instructions and confirm conformity.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
requirements.test_case: Measure the positions of the left and right bumper lamps relative to the median longitudinal plane, using their exterior geometrical form, and confirm symmetry.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, except that this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare the external shape of the left and right lamps of each pair and confirm they are mirror images about the median longitudinal plane.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval documents or measure the colour of both lamps of each pair and confirm they meet the same colorimetric requirements.

requirements.text: The lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics, except that this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.test_case: Compare the photometric test results of the left and right lamps of each pair and confirm they are substantially identical.

requirements.text: The lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo shall have only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo fitted on the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Count the illuminated manufacturer logos on the front of the vehicle and confirm there are only two lateral logos (one each side) or one central logo.

requirements.text: The lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo shall not include any logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos.
requirements.test_case: Inspect every logo in the bumper lamps and confirm each is a vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logo.

requirements.text: While lamps are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another, the lamps shall fulfil all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any.
requirements.test_case: For each grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamp in the bumper, verify colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility and electrical connection requirements for every function.

requirements.text: While all other functions with which a lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF, the lamp shall fulfil the photometric and colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry and colour of each function with all other grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated functions switched OFF.

requirements.text: When a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, and the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON, the front or rear position lamp shall fulfil the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions.
requirements.test_case: Switch ON the position lamp together with the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and measure that the colour of each other function remains within its limits.

requirements.text: The single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, except that these requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: On the lamp drawing or installed lamp, measure the projected area ratio of the distinct parts (≥ 60 % of the circumscribing quadrilateral) or the gap between adjacent parts (≤ 75 mm).

requirements.text: The single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that either the projection of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of the two lamps or retro reflectors occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projections of the said apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis; or the minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of two lamps or two independent retro reflectors does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: For a single lamp made of two "D" lamps, measure the projected area ratio (≥ 60 % of the circumscribing quadrilateral) or the distance between facing edges (≤ 75 mm).

requirements.text: The single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
requirements.test_case: For an interdependent lamp system, verify the projected area ratio or edge distance criteria of paragraph 5.7.2.1. on the installed lamp.

requirements.text: Two lamps or an even number of lamps in the shape of a band or strip shall be placed symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, extending on both sides to within at least 0.4 m of the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the band or strip lamps for symmetry about the median longitudinal plane and confirm each end reaches within 0.4 m of the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: Two lamps or an even number of lamps in the shape of a band or strip shall be not less than 0.8 m long.
requirements.test_case: Measure the length of the band or strip lamp and confirm it is at least 0.8 m.

requirements.text: The illumination of the surface of lamps in the shape of a band or strip shall be provided by not less than two light sources placed as close as possible to the ends.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the band or strip lamp design and confirm at least two light sources are located as close as possible to its ends.

requirements.text: Where the light-emitting surface of lamps in the shape of a band or strip is constituted by a number of juxtaposed elements, these individual light-emitting surfaces, when projected on a transverse plane, shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Project the juxtaposed light-emitting elements on a transverse plane and check the area ratio or gap criteria of paragraph 5.7.2.1.

requirements.text: While specific instructions are absent, the lamp shall not intentionally vary its photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Operate each bumper lamp in steady mode and record intensity, colour and apparent surface over time to confirm no intentional variation.

requirements.text: Direction-indicator lamps shall be flashing lamps.
requirements.test_case: Activate the direction indicator and confirm the lamp operates in flashing mode.

requirements.text: The vehicle-hazard warning signal shall be given by flashing lamps.
requirements.test_case: Activate the hazard warning signal and confirm the lamps operate in flashing mode.

requirements.text: Amber side-marker lamps complying with paragraph 6.18.7. shall be flashing lamps.
requirements.test_case: Activate the amber side-marker lamp function according to paragraph 6.18.7. and confirm it flashes.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be given by flashing lamps.
requirements.test_case: Trigger the emergency stop signal and confirm the lamps used operate in flashing mode.

requirements.text: When the photometric characteristics of any lamp vary in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, the lamp shall ensure any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Vary ambient light, switch other lamps ON/OFF and switch the lamp to its other function, and measure that photometric values stay within the lamp's technical provisions.

requirements.text: When the photometric characteristics of a direction indicator lamp of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a or 2b are varied during a flash by sequential activation of light sources, the sequential activation shall be as specified in paragraph 5.6. of UN Regulation No. 6. or paragraph 5.6.11. of UN Regulation No. [LSD], except that this provision shall not apply when direction indicator lamps of categories 2a and 2b are operated as emergency stop signal according to paragraph 6.23.1. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Record the light source activation sequence of a sequential direction indicator during a flash and compare it with paragraph 5.6. of UN R6 or 5.6.11. of UN R[LSD].

requirements.text: The lamp(s) used for answer-back signal shall operate according to the conditions specified in general specifications and/or in dedicated paragraph 6.27., except that the answer-back signal may flash and/or vary in luminous intensity and/or vary in apparent surface.
requirements.test_case: Lock and unlock the vehicle with the keyless entry system and verify the answer-back signal from the bumper lamps meets the general specifications and paragraph 6.27.

requirements.text: The vehicle shall not emit white light from a lamp fitted on the front of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) that is visible from the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Switch ON the white bumper lamps (including decorative lighting) and check from the rear of the vehicle that no white light from them is visible.

requirements.text: When viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4), there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings.
requirements.test_case: Move an observer through Zone 2 in a transverse plane 25 m behind the vehicle and confirm the apparent surface of no white bumper lamp is directly visible.

requirements.text: When there is doubt, the requirement that no red light shall be emitted to the front and no white light shall be emitted to the rear shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.test_case: Measure the luminous intensity of white light emitted rearwards by each front bumper lamp, including vehicle body influence, and confirm it does not exceed 0.25 cd per lamp.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Operate the lighting switch and confirm the bumper side-marker lamps switch ON and OFF only together with the position lamps and the rear registration plate lamp.

requirements.text: Where an interdependent lamp system is used, all light sources of the interdependent lamp system shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Switch the interdependent lamp system ON and OFF and confirm all its light sources change state simultaneously.

requirements.text: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the bumper design and confirm no signalling or other lamp (other than headlamps or front fog lamps) is concealed by a movable cover or device.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the direction-indicator lamp shall be amber.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of the direction-indicator lamp and confirm they are within the amber limits.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the hazard warning signal shall be amber.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the lamps providing the hazard warning signal and confirm they are amber.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the side-marker lamp shall be amber, except that the rearmost side-marker lamp can be red if it is grouped or combined or reciprocally incorporated with the rear position lamp, the rear end-outline marker lamp, the rear fog lamp, the stop lamp or is grouped or has part of the light emitting surface in common with the rear retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the bumper side-marker lamp and confirm it is within the amber limits.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the lamp used for the answer-back signal shall be in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.
requirements.test_case: Check the colour of the lamp used for the answer-back signal against the colour specified for that lamp.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use", unless this requirement is not practicable and the provisions of paragraph 5.21.1. or 5.21.2. are met.
requirements.test_case: Move each movable component of the bumper (e.g. EV charging-port flap, towing device cover) to every fixed position other than the normal position of use and verify that no more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of any of the named lamps or retro-reflectors is hidden.

requirements.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21. is not practicable, then additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component, unless the provisions of paragraph 5.21.2. are applied.
requirements.test_case: With the movable component in a fixed position that hides more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface, verify that the additional lamps switch ON and meet the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements of the lamps they replace.

requirements.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21. is not practicable and no additional lamps according to paragraph 5.21.1. are switched ON, then a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road, for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road, except that this does not apply to retro-reflectors.
requirements.test_case: Where neither paragraph 5.21. nor 5.21.1. is met, inspect the vehicle for a notice telling the user to warn other road users when the movable components are in the affected position(s).

requirements.text: The lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: On the vehicle with the bumper fitted, replace the UN R37 light source of each such lamp using only the tools supplied with the vehicle and no expert assistance, and confirm the light source is correctly seated and works.

requirements.text: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement of the light source of lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37.
requirements.test_case: Check that the documentation supplied with the vehicle contains a detailed description of the light source replacement procedure for the lamps in the bumper.

requirements.text: Where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37, the light source shall be replaceable as required in paragraph 5.23.
requirements.test_case: For a light source module with a UN R37 light source holder, replace the light source on the vehicle without expert assistance or special tools other than those supplied with the vehicle, and confirm correct fitting and operation.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity; no account is taken of obstacles that were already present when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.test_case: With the lamp installed in the bumper, check over the full angles of geometric visibility that no part of the fascia, grille, air intake inserts or other vehicle parts blocks light from any part of the apparent surface, ignoring obstacles already present at lamp type approval.

requirements.text: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, then the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
requirements.test_case: Review the geometric visibility measurement set-up and confirm that, where measurements are taken at a finite distance from the lamp, the direction of observation is shifted parallel.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, then proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Where the fascia or another vehicle part hides part of the apparent surface, measure the photometry of the installed lamp (or check the supplied proof) and confirm the unhidden part meets the photometric values of the device approval.

requirements.text: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal is reduced to 5º (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit shall be permitted to be reduced to 5º below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lamp mounting height according to paragraph 5.8.1.; if it is below 750 mm and the downward visibility angle is reduced to 5°, verify the photometric field of the installed optical unit down to 5° below the horizontal.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all the interdependent lamps of the interdependent lamp system are operated together.
requirements.test_case: Switch ON all interdependent lamps of the system together and verify the required angles of geometric visibility are met.

requirements.text: The lamps (devices) shall be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle, where applicable.
requirements.test_case: Check that each lamp installed in the bumper bears an approval marking and has a type approval to the device Regulation named in the relevant subparagraph of paragraph 6.

requirements.text: Where a light-signalling lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: For any light-signalling lamp in the bumper that incorporates a manufacturer logo, check the approval marking and approval documents show type approval to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: The lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128 shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only, except that this requirement does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, unless the light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Compare the light sources fitted in each lamp with the replaceable light source categories marked on the lamp and in its approval, and confirm they are approved light sources of those categories only.

requirements.text: Where lamps approved for and equipped with LED substitute light source(s) are used, the statement indicated in paragraph 3.2.8. shall be present and positive.
requirements.test_case: For any lamp in the bumper equipped with LED substitute light source(s), check that the positive statement of paragraph 3.2.8. is present and that the lamp bears the related LED substitute light source marking.

requirements.text: Arrangement "A" of direction-indicator lamps shall apply to all motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle and check that the direction-indicator lamps installed form arrangement "A".

requirements.text: The number of direction-indicator lamps shall be according to the arrangement.
requirements.test_case: Count the direction-indicator lamps on the vehicle and compare the number with the lamps required by arrangement "A".

requirements.text: The direction-indicator devices shall be type-approved according to the 01 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 6, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval marking and type-approval documents of each direction-indicator lamp for a UN R6 (01 or later series) or UN R148 (00 or later series) approval.

requirements.text: Where the distance between the edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the front direction-indicator lamp and that of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the dipped-beam headlamp and/or the front fog lamp, if there is one, is at least 40 mm, the two front direction-indicator lamps of arrangement "A" shall be of category 1 or 1a or 1b.
requirements.test_case: Measure the edge-to-edge distance between the apparent surfaces of the front direction-indicator lamp and the dipped-beam headlamp and/or front fog lamp and, where it is at least 40 mm, check that the lamp approval category is 1, 1a or 1b.

requirements.text: Where the distance between the edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the front direction-indicator lamp and that of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the dipped-beam headlamp and/or the front fog lamp, if there is one, is greater than 20 mm and less than 40 mm, the two front direction-indicator lamps of arrangement "A" shall be of category 1a or 1b.
requirements.test_case: Measure the edge-to-edge distance between the apparent surfaces and, where it is greater than 20 mm and less than 40 mm, check that the front direction-indicator lamp approval category is 1a or 1b.

requirements.text: Where the distance between the edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the front direction-indicator lamp and that of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the dipped-beam headlamp and/or the front fog lamp, if there is one, is less than or equal to 20 mm, the two front direction-indicator lamps of arrangement "A" shall be of category 1b.
requirements.test_case: Measure the edge-to-edge distance between the apparent surfaces and, where it is 20 mm or less, check that the front direction-indicator lamp approval category is 1b.

requirements.text: Arrangement "A" shall comprise two rear direction-indicator lamps of category 2a or 2b.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle and the lamp approval markings to confirm two rear direction-indicator lamps of category 2a or 2b are fitted.

requirements.text: For all M1 vehicles, arrangement "A" shall comprise two side direction-indicator lamps of category 5 (minimum requirements), except that it is permitted to replace category 5 side direction-indicator lamps by category 6 side direction-indicator lamps in all instances.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle and the approval markings of the side direction-indicator lamps to confirm two lamps of category 5 (or category 6) are fitted.

requirements.text: Where lamps combining the functions of front direction-indicator lamps (categories 1, 1a, 1b) and side direction-indicator lamps (categories 5 or 6) are fitted, two additional side direction-indicator lamps (categories 5 or 6) shall be permitted to be fitted to meet the visibility requirements of paragraph 6.5.5.
requirements.test_case: Where combined front/side direction-indicator lamps are fitted, check that any additional side direction-indicator lamps are of category 5 or 6, limited to two, and serve to meet the visibility requirements of paragraph 6.5.5.

requirements.text: Where an AFS is fitted, the distance to be considered for the choice of the category of the front direction-indicator lamp shall be the distance between the front direction-indicator lamp and the closest lighting unit in its closest position contributing to or performing a passing-beam mode.
requirements.test_case: On a vehicle with AFS, measure the distance from the front direction-indicator lamp to the closest AFS lighting unit in its closest passing-beam position and check the lamp category chosen against that distance.

requirements.text: The edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the direction-indicator lamp farthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, except that this condition shall not apply to the optional rear lamps.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outer edge of the apparent surface of each direction-indicator lamp to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle and check it is not more than 400 mm.

requirements.text: The distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes of the direction-indicator lamps shall not be less than 600 mm, except that this distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces of the paired direction-indicator lamps and check it is at least 600 mm (at least 400 mm if the vehicle overall width is less than 1,300 mm).

requirements.text: The height of the light-emitting surface of the side direction-indicator lamps of categories 5 or 6 shall not be less than 350 mm for M1 and N1 category of vehicles, and 500 mm for all other categories of vehicles, both measured from the lowest point, and not more than 1,500 mm, measured from the highest point.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the height above the ground of the lowest and highest points of the light-emitting surface of the side direction-indicator lamp and check it is at least 350 mm (M1/N1) and not more than 1,500 mm.

requirements.text: The height of the direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b, measured in accordance with paragraph 5.8., shall not be less than 350 mm and not more than 1,500 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height above the ground of the front direction-indicator lamp according to paragraph 5.8. and check it is between 350 mm and 1,500 mm.

requirements.text: If the structure of the vehicle does not permit the upper limit of 1,500 mm to be respected, and if the optional rear lamps are not installed, the height of the side direction-indicator lamps of categories 5 and 6 shall not be more than 2,300 mm.
requirements.test_case: Where the vehicle structure does not permit 1,500 mm and no optional rear lamps are installed, measure the height of the highest point of the side direction-indicator lamp and check it is not more than 2,300 mm.

requirements.text: If the structure of the vehicle does not permit the upper limit of 1,500 mm to be respected, and if the optional rear lamps are not installed, the height of the direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b shall not be more than 2,100 mm.
requirements.test_case: Where the vehicle structure does not permit 1,500 mm and no optional rear lamps are installed, measure the height of the direction-indicator lamp of category 1, 1a, 1b, 2a or 2b and check it is not more than 2,100 mm.

requirements.text: The distance between the light-emitting surface of the side direction-indicator lamp (categories 5 and 6) and the transverse plane which marks the forward boundary of the vehicle's overall length shall not exceed 1,800 mm, except that this distance shall not exceed 2,500 mm (a) for M1 and N1 category vehicles; (b) for all other categories of vehicles if the structure of the vehicle makes it impossible to comply with the minimum angles of visibility.
requirements.test_case: Measure longitudinally from the forward boundary of the vehicle to the light-emitting surface of the side direction-indicator lamp and check it does not exceed 2,500 mm for the M1 vehicle.

requirements.text: Optional category 5 side direction indicator lamps shall be fitted, spaced evenly, along the length of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Where optional category 5 side direction-indicator lamps are fitted, measure their longitudinal positions and check they are evenly spaced along the vehicle length.

requirements.text: The horizontal angles of geometric visibility of the direction-indicator lamps shall be as shown in the figure of paragraph 6.5., except that for the direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Check on the installed lamp, by goniometric measurement or CAD sight-line analysis, that the apparent surface is unobstructed over the horizontal angles of the figure in paragraph 6.5.

requirements.text: The vertical angles of geometric visibility of the direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b and 5 shall be 15° above and below the horizontal, except that (a) where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) where an optional rear lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Check on the installed lamp that the apparent surface is visible 15° above and 15° below the horizontal (5° below if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The vertical angles of geometric visibility of the direction indicator lamps of category 6 shall be 30° above and 5° below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Check on the installed category 6 side direction-indicator lamp that the apparent surface is visible from 30° above to 5° below the horizontal.

requirements.text: The value of 5° given for the dead angle of visibility to the rear of the side direction-indicator shall be an upper limit for d ≤ 1.80 m (for M1 and N1 category vehicles d ≤ 2.50 m).
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance d and the rearward dead angle of visibility of the side direction-indicator on the vehicle and check the dead angle does not exceed 5° with d ≤ 2.50 m for the M1 vehicle.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, at the discretion of the manufacturer, as an alternative to paragraph 6.5.5.1., the front and rear direction indicator lamps, as well as side-marker lamps, shall have the horizontal angles of geometric visibility shown in the figure of paragraph 6.5.5.2., except that for the direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Where the manufacturer chooses this alternative, check on the installed front direction-indicator and side-marker lamps that the apparent surface is unobstructed over the horizontal angles of the figure in paragraph 6.5.5.2.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, at the discretion of the manufacturer, as an alternative to paragraph 6.5.5.1., the front and rear direction indicator lamps, as well as side-marker lamps, shall have vertical angles of geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Where the manufacturer chooses this alternative, check on the installed lamps that the apparent surface is visible 15° above and 15° below the horizontal (5° below if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles using the alternative of paragraph 6.5.5.2., the value of 5° given for the dead angle of visibility to the rear of the side direction-indicator shall be an upper limit for d ≤ 2.50 m.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance d and the rearward dead angle of visibility of the side direction-indicator and check the dead angle does not exceed 5° with d ≤ 2.50 m.

requirements.text: To be considered visible, the lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, except for side direction-indicators of categories 5 and 6.
requirements.test_case: Determine, at each limit angle of geometric visibility, the unobstructed projected apparent surface of the installed lamp and check it is at least 12.5 cm².

requirements.text: When determining the unobstructed view of the apparent surface of the lamp, the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded.
requirements.test_case: Review the visible-area calculation and check that the illuminating surface of any non-light-transmitting retro-reflector is excluded from the 12.5 cm².

requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamps shall be oriented according to the specifications for installation by the manufacturer, if any.
requirements.test_case: Compare the installed orientation of the direction-indicator lamp with the manufacturer's installation specification.

requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamps shall switch ON independently of the other lamps.
requirements.test_case: Operate the direction-indicator control with all other lamps OFF and with other lamps ON and check that the direction-indicator lamps switch ON independently.

requirements.text: All direction-indicator lamps on one side of a vehicle shall be switched ON and OFF automatically as defined by applicable UN Regulations and/or by means of one control.
requirements.test_case: Operate the direction-indicator control for each side and check that all direction-indicator lamps on that side switch ON and OFF together from the one control or automatic function.

requirements.text: All direction-indicator lamps on one side of a vehicle shall flash in phase.
requirements.test_case: Record the light output of all direction-indicator lamps on one side during operation and check that they flash in phase.

requirements.text: Where amber side-marker lamps are mounted on M1 and N1 vehicles less than 6 m in length with an arrangement complying with paragraph 6.5.5.2., the amber side-marker lamps shall also flash at the same frequency (in phase) with the direction-indicator lamps.
requirements.test_case: Operate the direction indicators and record the amber side-marker lamp and direction-indicator outputs to check they flash at the same frequency and in phase.

requirements.text: A direction indicator capable of being activated in different modes (static or sequential) shall not switch between both modes once activated.
requirements.test_case: Activate the direction indicator in each mode and check that it does not change between static and sequential mode while activated.

requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b shall have a mandatory operating tell-tale, which may be visual or auditory or both, except that for the optional direction-indicator lamps on motor vehicles and trailers, operating tell-tale shall not be mandatory.
requirements.test_case: Operate the direction indicators and check that a visual and/or auditory operating tell-tale is provided for the category 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b lamps.

requirements.text: Where the operating tell-tale is visual, the operating tell-tale shall be a flashing light which, at least in the event of the malfunction of any of these direction-indicator lamps, is either extinguished, or remains alight without flashing, or shows a marked change of frequency.
requirements.test_case: Disconnect one direction-indicator lamp and check that the visual tell-tale is extinguished, stays lit without flashing or shows a marked change of frequency.

requirements.text: Where the operating tell-tale is entirely auditory, the operating tell-tale shall be clearly audible.
requirements.test_case: Operate the direction indicators and check by listening at the driver's seat that the auditory tell-tale is clearly audible.

requirements.text: Where the operating tell-tale is entirely auditory, the operating tell-tale shall show a marked change of frequency, at least in the event of the malfunction of any of these direction-indicator lamps.
requirements.test_case: Disconnect one direction-indicator lamp and check that the auditory tell-tale shows a marked change of frequency.

requirements.text: The operating tell-tale shall be activated by the signal produced according to paragraph 6.2.2. of UN Regulation No. 6, or paragraph 5.6.3. of the 00 series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148, or paragraph 4.6.1.4. of the 01 series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148, or another suitable way.
requirements.test_case: Review the circuit design and test that the tell-tale is driven by the lamp signal per UN R6 paragraph 6.2.2., UN R148 paragraph 5.6.3. (00 series) or 4.6.1.4. (01 series), or another suitable way.

requirements.text: Where a motor vehicle is equipped to draw a trailer, the motor vehicle shall be fitted with a special visual operational tell-tale for the direction-indicator lamps on the trailer, unless the tell-tale of the drawing vehicle allows the failure of any one of the direction-indicator lamps on the vehicle combination thus formed to be detected.
requirements.test_case: On a vehicle equipped to draw a trailer, check for a separate visual trailer direction-indicator tell-tale, or that a failed lamp on the combination is detected by the vehicle tell-tale.

requirements.text: The light of the direction-indicator lamps shall be a flashing light flashing 90 ± 30 times per minute.
requirements.test_case: Measure the flash frequency of the operating direction-indicator lamps and check it is between 60 and 120 flashes per minute.

requirements.text: When the light-signal control is operated, the operation shall be followed within not more than one second by the emission of light.
requirements.test_case: Record the time from operation of the direction-indicator control to first light emission and check it is not more than 1 s.

requirements.text: When the light-signal control is operated, the operation shall be followed within not more than one and one-half seconds by the first extinction of the light.
requirements.test_case: Record the time from operation of the direction-indicator control to the first extinction of the light and check it is not more than 1.5 s.

requirements.text: Where a motor vehicle is equipped to draw a trailer, the control of the direction-indicator lamps on the drawing vehicle shall also operate the indicator lamps of the trailer.
requirements.test_case: Connect a trailer or trailer simulator and check that operating the vehicle direction-indicator control also operates the trailer indicator lamps.

requirements.text: If one direction-indicator lamp fails, other than by short-circuit, then the other direction-indicator lamps shall continue to flash, except that the frequency in this condition may be different from that prescribed.
requirements.test_case: Open-circuit one direction-indicator lamp and check that the remaining direction-indicator lamps continue to flash.

requirements.text: The hazard warning signal shall be given by simultaneous operation of the direction-indicator lamps in accordance with the requirements of paragraph 6.5.
requirements.test_case: Activate the hazard warning signal and check that all direction-indicator lamps operate simultaneously and meet paragraph 6.5.

requirements.text: When activated simultaneously, all direction indicators of the category 1 (1, 1a, 1b) shall operate in the same mode, i.e. static or sequential.
requirements.test_case: Activate the hazard warning signal and check that all category 1, 1a and 1b direction indicators operate in the same static or sequential mode.

requirements.text: When activated simultaneously, all direction indicators of the category 2 (2a, 2b) shall operate in the same mode, i.e. static or sequential.
requirements.test_case: Activate the hazard warning signal and check that all category 2a and 2b direction indicators operate in the same static or sequential mode.

requirements.text: The number of lamps giving the hazard warning signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.2.
requirements.test_case: Count the lamps operating with the hazard warning signal and compare with paragraph 6.5.2.

requirements.text: The arrangement of the lamps giving the hazard warning signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.3.
requirements.test_case: Check the arrangement of the lamps operating with the hazard warning signal against paragraph 6.5.3.

requirements.text: The position in width of the lamps giving the hazard warning signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.4.1.
requirements.test_case: Measure the width position of the hazard warning lamps on the vehicle and check it against paragraph 6.5.4.1.

requirements.text: The position in height of the lamps giving the hazard warning signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.4.2.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the hazard warning lamps above the ground and check it against paragraph 6.5.4.2.

requirements.text: The position in length of the lamps giving the hazard warning signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.4.3.
requirements.test_case: Measure the longitudinal position of the hazard warning lamps and check it against paragraph 6.5.4.3.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the lamps giving the hazard warning signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.5.
requirements.test_case: Check the geometric visibility of the installed hazard warning lamps against paragraph 6.5.5.

requirements.text: The orientation of the lamps giving the hazard warning signal shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.6.
requirements.test_case: Compare the installed orientation of the hazard warning lamps with the manufacturer's installation specification per paragraph 6.5.6.

requirements.text: The hazard warning signal shall be operated by means of a separate manual control enabling all the direction-indicator lamps to flash in phase.
requirements.test_case: Operate the separate manual hazard warning control and check that all direction-indicator lamps flash in phase.

requirements.text: When the hazard warning signal is switched ON automatically in the event of a vehicle being involved in a collision or after the emergency stop signal has been switched OFF, as specified in paragraph 6.23., the hazard warning signal shall be permitted to be switched OFF manually.
requirements.test_case: Trigger the automatic activation (collision signal or end of emergency stop signal) and check that the hazard warning signal can be switched OFF manually.

requirements.text: When the hazard warning signal is switched ON automatically to indicate to other road-users the risk of imminent danger as defined by Regulations, the signal shall remain switched ON until it is manually or automatically switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Trigger the automatic imminent-danger activation and check that the hazard warning signal stays ON until it is switched OFF manually or automatically.

requirements.text: Where amber side-marker lamps are mounted on M1 and N1 vehicles less than 6 m in length with an arrangement complying with paragraph 6.5.5.2., the amber side-marker lamps shall also flash at the same frequency (in phase) with the direction-indicator lamps.
requirements.test_case: Activate the hazard warning signal and record the amber side-marker and direction-indicator outputs to check they flash at the same frequency and in phase.

requirements.text: The hazard warning signal shall have a mandatory flashing closed-circuit tell-tale.
requirements.test_case: Activate the hazard warning signal and check that a flashing closed-circuit tell-tale operates in the driver's field of view.

requirements.text: The hazard warning signal shall fulfil the other requirements as specified in paragraph 6.5.9.
requirements.test_case: Check the hazard warning signal on the vehicle against each requirement of paragraph 6.5.9.

requirements.text: Where a power-driven vehicle is equipped to draw a trailer, the hazard warning signal control shall also be capable of bringing the direction-indicator lamps on the trailer into action.
requirements.test_case: With a trailer connected, operate the hazard warning signal control and verify that the direction-indicator lamps on the trailer are brought into action.

requirements.text: The hazard warning signal shall be able to function even if the device which starts or stops the propulsion system is in a position which makes it impossible to start the propulsion system.
requirements.test_case: Place the device which starts or stops the propulsion system in a position which makes it impossible to start the propulsion system, operate the hazard warning signal control and verify that the hazard warning signal functions.

requirements.text: The number of front position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Count the front position lamps installed on the vehicle and check that each bears a valid approval marking to UN Regulation No. 7 (02 or later series) or UN Regulation No. 148 (00 or later series).

requirements.text: The point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the front position lamp which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance between the outermost point of the apparent surface of each front position lamp in the direction of the reference axis and the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, and verify it is not more than 400 mm.

requirements.text: The front position lamps shall be at a height above the ground of not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm for O1 and O2 categories of vehicles, or if for any other categories of vehicles the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm).
requirements.test_case: Measure on the unladen vehicle the height above the ground of the lowest and highest points of the apparent surface of each front position lamp according to paragraph 5.8 and verify it lies between 250 mm and 1,500 mm (or 2,100 mm where the bodywork shape justifies it).

requirements.text: Where the front position lamp and another lamp are reciprocally incorporated, the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the other lamp shall be used to verify compliance with the positioning requirements (paragraphs 6.9.4.1. to 6.9.4.3.).
requirements.test_case: For a front position lamp reciprocally incorporated with another lamp, verify that the width, height and length position checks of paragraphs 6.9.4.1. to 6.9.4.3. are performed using the apparent surface of the other lamp.

requirements.text: The horizontal angle of geometric visibility of the front position lamp shall be 45° inwards and 80° outwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane, and in the case of trailers, the angle inwards may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Check on the vehicle (or by CAD) that the apparent surface of each front position lamp is unobstructed from 45° inwards (20° under the H plane if mounted below 750 mm) to 80° outwards.

requirements.text: The vertical angle of geometric visibility of the front position lamp shall be 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Check on the vehicle (or by CAD) that the apparent surface of each front position lamp is unobstructed from 15° above to 15° below the horizontal (5° below if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: Where a front side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, for M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.9.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, the front position lamp shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 45° outwards to 45° inwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: On an M1 vehicle with a front side-marker lamp using this alternative, verify by measurement or CAD that each front position lamp is visible from 45° outwards to 45° inwards (20° inwards under the H plane if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: Where a front side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, for M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.9.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, the front position lamp shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: On an M1 vehicle with a front side-marker lamp using this alternative, verify by measurement or CAD that each front position lamp is visible from 15° above to 15° below the horizontal (5° below if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: To be considered visible, the front position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 cm2.
requirements.test_case: Determine by CAD projection or measurement the unobstructed apparent surface of the front position lamp in each direction of the visibility field and verify it is at least 12.5 cm2.

requirements.text: When determining the unobstructed view of the apparent surface of the front position lamp, the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded.
requirements.test_case: Review the visible-area calculation and verify that the illuminating surface of any non-light-transmitting retro-reflector has been excluded from the 12.5 cm2 area.

requirements.text: The electrical connections for front position lamps shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11, except that if a front position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator, the electrical connection of the front position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.test_case: Operate the position lamp switch and the direction indicators on the vehicle and verify that the front position lamps switch ON and OFF simultaneously with the lamps listed in paragraph 5.11, apart from the permitted switch-OFF of a reciprocally incorporated front position lamp during direction-indicator operation.

requirements.text: While the daytime running lamps are not switched ON, the front position lamps shall have a mandatory closed-circuit tell-tale, except that this tell-tale shall not be required if the instrument panel lighting can only switch ON simultaneously with the front position lamps.
requirements.test_case: With the daytime running lamps OFF, switch the front position lamps ON and verify that a closed-circuit tell-tale is activated, unless the instrument panel lighting can only switch ON together with the front position lamps.

requirements.text: The closed-circuit tell-tale of the front position lamps shall be non-flashing.
requirements.test_case: Switch the front position lamps ON and verify that the closed-circuit tell-tale is lit steadily and does not flash.

requirements.text: The tell-tale indicating failure of the front position lamp shall be mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the component approval of the front position lamp for a failure tell-tale condition and, if present, simulate a lamp failure and verify that the failure tell-tale is activated.

requirements.text: Where one or more infrared radiation generator(s) is (are) installed inside the front position lamp, the infrared radiation generator(s) shall be switched ON only when the headlamp on the same side of the vehicle is switched ON and the vehicle is in forward motion.
requirements.test_case: With an infrared radiation generator inside the front position lamp, verify that it is switched ON only when the headlamp on the same side is ON and the vehicle is moving forwards, and is OFF in all other states.

requirements.text: If the front position lamp or the headlamp on the same side fails, then the infrared radiation generator(s) installed inside the front position lamp shall be automatically switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Simulate a failure of the front position lamp and of the headlamp on the same side in turn and verify that the infrared radiation generator(s) switch OFF automatically.

requirements.text: Where an AFS providing a bending mode is installed, the front position lamp shall be permitted to be swivelled together with a lighting unit to which the front position lamp is reciprocally incorporated.
requirements.test_case: Where an AFS bending mode is fitted, verify that only a front position lamp reciprocally incorporated with the swivelling lighting unit swivels together with that unit.

requirements.text: The number of side retro-reflectors shall be such that the requirements for longitudinal positioning are complied with.
requirements.test_case: Check on the vehicle drawing that the number of side retro-reflectors per side satisfies the longitudinal positioning requirements of paragraph 6.17.4.3.

requirements.text: The side retro-reflectors shall be type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval marking and type-approval certificate of the side retro-reflector for a Class IA or IB approval under UN R3 (02 series or later) or UN R150 (00 series or later).

requirements.text: The side retro-reflectors shall be at a height above the ground of not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively or if the presence of the device is not mandatory according to paragraph 6.17.1.).
requirements.test_case: Measure on the unladen vehicle the height of the lowest and highest points of the illuminating surface of the side retro-reflector above the ground and compare with 250 mm and the applicable maximum.

requirements.text: At least one side retro-reflector shall be fitted to the middle third of the vehicle, the foremost side retro-reflector being not further than 3 m (4 m for semi-trailers) from the front, except that for motor vehicles the length of which does not exceed 6 m it is sufficient to have one side retro-reflector fitted within the first third and/or one within the last third of the vehicle length.
requirements.test_case: Measure the longitudinal position of each side retro-reflector relative to the vehicle front and vehicle length and check it lies in the required third and within 3 m of the front.

requirements.text: For motor vehicles the length of which does not exceed 6 m, one side retro-reflector shall be fitted within the first third and/or one within the last third of the vehicle length.
requirements.test_case: On the M1 vehicle drawing, verify that the bumper side retro-reflector lies within the first third (or another lies within the last third) of the vehicle length.

requirements.text: For M1 vehicles the length of which exceeds 6 m but does not exceed 7 m, one side retro-reflector shall be fitted not further than 3 m from the front and one within the last third of the vehicle length.
requirements.test_case: For an M1 vehicle between 6 m and 7 m long, measure that one side retro-reflector is no more than 3 m from the front and one is within the last third of the length.

requirements.text: The distance between the rearmost side retro-reflector and the rear of the vehicle shall not exceed 1 m.
requirements.test_case: Measure the longitudinal distance from the rearmost side retro-reflector to the rear end of the vehicle and check it is not more than 1 m.

requirements.text: The side retro-reflectors shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 45° to the front and to the rear.
requirements.test_case: Check on the installed vehicle (or CAD) that the illuminating surface of the side retro-reflector is unobstructed over 45° to the front and to the rear.

requirements.text: The side retro-reflectors shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 10° above and below the horizontal, except that where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Check on the installed vehicle (or CAD) that the side retro-reflector is unobstructed over 10° up and 10° down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm per paragraph 5.8.1.).

requirements.text: The illuminating surface of the side retro-reflector shall be permitted to have parts in common with the apparent surface of any other side lamp.
requirements.test_case: Review the lamp design to confirm that any surface shared between the side retro-reflector and another side lamp is limited to a side lamp's apparent surface.

requirements.text: The SM1 type of side-marker lamp shall be used on all categories of vehicles, except that the SM2 type of side-marker lamps may be used on the M1 category of vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval marking of the side-marker lamp shows SM1, or SM2 for installation on an M1 vehicle.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles less than 6 m in length, side-marker lamps shall be used if they supplement the reduced geometric visibility requirements of front position lamps conforming to paragraph 6.9.5.2. and rear position lamps conforming to paragraph 6.10.5.2.
requirements.test_case: Where the vehicle's front and rear position lamps use the reduced visibility of paragraphs 6.9.5.2. and 6.10.5.2., verify that side-marker lamps are installed on the vehicle.

requirements.text: The minimum number of side-marker lamps per side shall be such that the rules for longitudinal positioning are complied with.
requirements.test_case: Check on the vehicle drawing that the number of side-marker lamps per side satisfies the longitudinal positioning rules of paragraph 6.18.4.3.

requirements.text: The side-marker lamps shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 91, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval marking and type-approval certificate of the side-marker lamp for an approval under UN R91 (00 series or later) or UN R148 (00 series or later).

requirements.text: The side-marker lamps shall be at a height above the ground of not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm).
requirements.test_case: Measure on the unladen vehicle the height of the lowest and highest points of the apparent surface of the side-marker lamp above the ground and compare with 250 mm and 1,500 mm (2,100 mm).

requirements.text: At least one side-marker lamp shall be fitted to the middle third of the vehicle, the foremost side-marker lamp being not further than 3 m (4 m for semi-trailers) from the front, except that for vehicles the length of which does not exceed 6 m and for chassis-cabs it is sufficient to have one side-marker lamp fitted within the first third and/or within the last third of the vehicle length.
requirements.test_case: Measure the longitudinal position of each side-marker lamp relative to the vehicle front and vehicle length and check it lies in the required third and within 3 m of the front.

requirements.text: The distance between two adjacent side-marker lamps shall not exceed 3 m, except that if the structure, design or the operational use of the vehicle makes it impossible to comply with such a requirement, this distance may be increased to 4 m.
requirements.test_case: Measure the longitudinal distance between adjacent side-marker lamps on each side and check it is not more than 3 m (4 m where justified).

requirements.text: The distance between the rearmost side-marker lamp and the rear of the vehicle shall not exceed 1 m.
requirements.test_case: Measure the longitudinal distance from the rearmost side-marker lamp to the rear end of the vehicle and check it is not more than 1 m.

requirements.text: For vehicles the length of which does not exceed 6 m and for chassis-cabs, one side-marker lamp shall be fitted within the first third and/or within the last third of the vehicle length.
requirements.test_case: On the M1 vehicle drawing, verify that the bumper side-marker lamp lies within the first third (or another lies within the last third) of the vehicle length.

requirements.text: For M1 vehicles the length of which exceeds 6 m but does not exceed 7 m, one side-marker lamp shall be fitted not further than 3 m from the front and one within the last third of the vehicle length.
requirements.test_case: For an M1 vehicle between 6 m and 7 m long, measure that one side-marker lamp is no more than 3 m from the front and one is within the last third of the length.

requirements.text: The side-marker lamps shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 45° to the front and to the rear, except that for vehicles on which the installation of the side-marker lamps is optional this value can be reduced to 30°.
requirements.test_case: Check on the installed vehicle (or CAD) that the apparent surface of the side-marker lamp is unobstructed over 45° (30° where installation is optional) to the front and to the rear.
