requirements.text: Where the vehicle is equipped with side-marker lamps used to supplement the reduced geometric visibility of front and rear direction indicator lamps conforming to paragraph 6.5.5.2. and/or position lamps conforming to paragraphs 6.9.5.2. and 6.10.5.2., the horizontal angles of geometric visibility of the side-marker lamps shall be 45° towards the front and rear ends of the vehicle and 30° towards the centre of the vehicle (see the figure in paragraph 6.5.5.2.).
requirements.test_case: For a supplementing side-marker lamp, check on the installed vehicle (or CAD) visibility of 45° towards the nearer vehicle end and 30° towards the vehicle centre.

requirements.text: The side-marker lamps shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 10° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Check on the installed vehicle (or CAD) that the side-marker lamp is unobstructed over 10° up and 10° down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm per paragraph 5.8.1.).

requirements.text: Where amber side-marker lamps on M1 and N1 category vehicles less than 6 m in length are wired to flash, the flashing shall be in phase and at the same frequency with the direction-indicator lamps at the same side of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Operate the direction indicators on each side and record the side-marker lamp and direction-indicator signals to confirm the same frequency and phase.

requirements.text: Where a tell-tale for the side-marker lamps exists, the function of the tell-tale shall be carried out by the tell-tale required for the front and rear position lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check in the vehicle wiring and instrument cluster that any side-marker lamp tell-tale is the same tell-tale as the front and rear position lamp tell-tale.

requirements.text: The tell-tale indicating failure of the side-marker lamps shall be mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review the side-marker lamp approval (UN R91/R148) for a failure tell-tale condition and, if required, simulate a lamp failure and check the tell-tale activates.

requirements.text: When the rearmost side-marker lamp is combined with the rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with the rear fog-lamp or stop lamp, the photometric characteristics of the side-marker lamp shall be permitted to be modified during the entire time the rear fog lamp or stop lamp are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Review the lamp configuration and, with the rear fog lamp or stop lamp switched ON, confirm any change in side-marker photometry occurs only in this combined configuration.

requirements.text: Where rear side-marker lamps flash with the rear direction-indicator lamp, the rear side-marker lamps shall be amber.
requirements.test_case: Measure the colour of a flashing rear side-marker lamp and confirm it is within the amber chromaticity limits.

requirements.text: When an optional side-marker lamp is grouped or combined with a position lamp that is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with the direction indicator, the electrical connection of the side-marker lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle shall be permitted to be such that the side-marker lamp is switched OFF during the entire period (both ON and OFF cycle) of activation of the direction indicator lamp.
requirements.test_case: Activate the direction indicator on each side and confirm that any switching OFF of the grouped or combined side-marker lamp covers the entire ON and OFF cycle on that side only.

requirements.text: Where lamps are switched ON as exterior courtesy lamps, the lamps shall be approved lamps emitting white light, with the exception of main beam head lamps, daytime running lamps and reversing lamps, except that in addition rear position lamps, the parking lamps, the side marker lamps and/or the end-outline marker lamps may be switched ON and the conditions of paragraphs 5.11. and 5.12. may not apply.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp list and wiring logic of the exterior courtesy function and confirm that only approved white lamps (no main-beam, daytime running or reversing lamps), plus optionally rear position, parking, side-marker and/or end-outline marker lamps, are switched ON.

requirements.text: The apparent surface of the exterior courtesy lamps shall not be directly visible if viewed by an observer moving on the boundary of a zone on a transverse plane 10 m from the front of the vehicle, a transverse plane 10 m from the rear of the vehicle, and two longitudinal planes 10 m from each side of the vehicle, these four planes extending from 1 m to 3 m above and perpendicular to the ground as shown in Annex 14.
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 14 visual test with an observer moving along the four planes 10 m from the vehicle between 1 m and 3 m height and confirm the apparent surface of no exterior courtesy lamp is directly visible.

requirements.text: When requested by the applicant and with the consent of the Technical Service, the requirements of paragraph 6.24.9.3. may be verified by a drawing or simulation, or shall be deemed satisfied if the applicant can prove that the luminous intensity of light emitted directly during the observation test described in Annex 14 is not more than 0.5 cd per lamp.
requirements.test_case: Review the drawing/simulation or measure the directly emitted luminous intensity of each exterior courtesy lamp in the Annex 14 observation zone and confirm it is not more than 0.5 cd per lamp.

requirements.text: The number of exterior courtesy lamps shall be one or two, except that further exterior courtesy lamps to illuminate steps and/or door handles, and/or the area around the vehicle are permitted.
requirements.test_case: Count the exterior courtesy lamps installed on the vehicle and check that any lamps beyond two illuminate steps, door handles or the area around the vehicle.

requirements.text: Each door handle or step shall be illuminated by not more than one exterior courtesy lamp.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each door handle and step with the exterior courtesy lamps switched ON and confirm that each is illuminated by no more than one lamp.

requirements.text: The arrangement of the exterior courtesy lamps shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 6.24.9.3.
requirements.test_case: Review the arrangement of the exterior courtesy lamps against the requirements of paragraph 6.24.9.3.

requirements.text: The exterior courtesy lamp(s) shall not be switched ON unless the vehicle is stationary and one or more of the following conditions is satisfied: (a) the propulsion system is stopped; or (b) a driver or passenger door is opened or after being closed; or (c) a load compartment door is opened or after being closed.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to switch ON the exterior courtesy lamp(s) in motion and when stationary with the propulsion system running and all doors closed, and confirm they only switch ON when stationary with one of conditions (a) to (c) satisfied.

requirements.text: When the vehicle is no longer stationary, the exterior courtesy lamp(s) shall be switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: With the exterior courtesy lamp(s) switched ON, move the vehicle off and confirm the lamps switch OFF.

requirements.text: The exterior courtesy lamps shall be permitted to be switched ON and/or switched OFF manually or automatically.
requirements.test_case: Review the control strategy of the exterior courtesy lamps and confirm manual and/or automatic switching ON and OFF stays within the conditions of paragraph 6.24.9.1.

requirements.text: While the exterior courtesy lamp or lamps vary in luminous intensity and/or vary in apparent surface, or the photometric characteristics of the exterior courtesy lamp(s) vary in relation to the position of vehicle users, no sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.
requirements.test_case: Record the luminous intensity of the exterior courtesy lamp(s) during each intensity, apparent surface or user-position-dependent transition and confirm there is no sharp variation of intensity.

requirements.text: The exterior courtesy lamp(s) shall not flash.
requirements.test_case: Operate the exterior courtesy lamp(s) in all their modes and confirm by observation or photodetector recording that they do not flash.

requirements.text: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of this Regulation or of another Regulation shall not be part of a unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
requirements.test_case: Review the lamp unit build-up and approvals to confirm that every lamp grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with the side signalling lamp (e.g. the decorative grille light ring) satisfies the provisions of R148 or another Regulation, or is kept outside the unit.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp drawing and a production sample to confirm that a marking area large enough for the approval marking and the markings of paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6. is provided.

requirements.text: The markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the markings visually for legibility and rub them with a cloth soaked in water and in solvent to confirm they remain legible and are not removed.

requirements.text: The value for “a” shall be at least 5 mm with regard to the size of the approval marking.
requirements.test_case: Measure the approval marking on the sample and confirm that dimension “a” is at least 5 mm.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking on the lamp and confirm it shows a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the approving country.

requirements.text: The four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2., shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking on the lamp and confirm that the four to six-digit sequential number of the approval number is present and placed close to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: Compare the function symbols in the lamp marking (e.g. 5 or 6 for side direction indicators, SM1 or SM2 for side-marker lamps) with Table 1 of paragraph 3.2.4. and the approved functions.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and confirm it contains "148R" followed by the two digits of the series of amendments in force at the time of approval.

requirements.text: The lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately shall be provided with a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
requirements.test_case: For left- and right-hand specific bumper lamps, inspect the marking for a horizontal arrow and check that it indicates the mounting position of the lamp.

requirements.text: In the case of direction indicators categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12, the arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: With the direction indicator lamp fitted in the bumper, check that the horizontal arrow on the lamp points outwards from the vehicle.

requirements.text: In the case of front or rear position lamps, front or rear end-outline marker lamps, the arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: With the position lamp or end-outline marker lamp fitted in the bumper, check that the horizontal arrow on the lamp points outwards from the vehicle.

requirements.text: In the case of direction indicators of categories 5 and 6 and combined parking lamps, the arrow shall be directed towards the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: With the side direction indicator (category 5 or 6) fitted in the bumper corner, check that the horizontal arrow on the lamp points towards the front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For direction indicators of category 6, the lamp shall show an indication "R" or "L", indicating the right or left side of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each category 6 side direction indicator and confirm it is marked "R" or "L" matching the side of the vehicle on which it is fitted.

requirements.text: Where a lamp may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps, the lamp shall bear the additional letter "D" to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: For a lamp approved as part of an assembly of two independent lamps, inspect the marking for the letter "D" to the right of the function symbol.

requirements.text: Where a lamp is used as part of an interdependent lamp system, the lamp shall bear the additional letter "Y" to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: For a lamp used as part of an interdependent lamp system, inspect the marking for the letter "Y" to the right of the function symbol.

requirements.text: Lamps with reduced light distribution, see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3, shall bear a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
requirements.test_case: For a low-mounted bumper lamp approved with reduced light distribution according to paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3, inspect the marking for a downward vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment.

requirements.text: The lamps shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.test_case: Inspect a production sample of the side signalling lamp and confirm the approval marking is present.

requirements.text: The lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect a production sample of the lamp and confirm the trade name or mark of the applicant is present.

requirements.text: Lamps, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, shall bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed.
requirements.test_case: For a lamp with replaceable light sources, inspect the lamp and confirm it is marked with the prescribed light source category or categories.

requirements.text: In the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), lamps, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, shall also bear a marking indicating the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s).
requirements.test_case: For a lamp approved for LED substitute light sources, inspect the lamp and confirm it is also marked with the LED substitute light source category or categories.

requirements.text: Lamps with an electronic light source control gear, and/or a variable luminous intensity control, and/or a secondary operating mode, and/or non-replaceable light sources shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: For an LED lamp or a lamp with control gear, variable intensity control or a secondary operating mode, inspect the lamp for the rated voltage (6V, 12V or 24V) or voltage range marking.

requirements.text: The light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant in case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used.
requirements.test_case: Where replaceable light source modules are used, inspect each module for the trade name or mark of the applicant.

requirements.text: The light source module(s) shall bear the specific identification code of the module where replaceable light source module(s) is/are used.
requirements.test_case: Where replaceable light source modules are used, inspect each module for its specific identification code.

requirements.text: The specific identification code of the module shall comprise the starting letters “MD” for “MODULE” followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1, in case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used.
requirements.test_case: Check that the module identification code starts with "MD" followed by the approval mark without the circle.

requirements.text: Where replaceable light source module(s) is/are used and several non-identical light source modules are used, the specific identification code of the module shall be followed by additional symbols or characters.
requirements.test_case: Where several non-identical modules are used in the lamp, check that each module identification code is followed by distinguishing additional symbols or characters.

requirements.text: The light source module and the lamp shall both have marks from the same applicant, where the approval mark on the light source module does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp in which the module is used, in case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used.
requirements.test_case: Compare the approval marks on the module and on the lamp and confirm both are issued to the same applicant.

requirements.text: The light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage in case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used.
requirements.test_case: Where replaceable light source modules are used, inspect each module for the rated voltage or voltage range marking.

requirements.text: The lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii) in case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used.
requirements.test_case: Where replaceable light source modules are used, inspect the lamp for the specific identification code of the module.

requirements.text: The lamp shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage in case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used.
requirements.test_case: Where replaceable light source modules are used, inspect the lamp for the rated voltage or voltage range marking.

requirements.text: Where an electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control is part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, the electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: For a separate control gear or variable intensity control belonging to the lamp, inspect it for its identification number and the manufacturer's name.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp construction and confirm that the part carrying the approval marking cannot be separated from the light-emitting transparent part (lens).

requirements.text: When the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened, the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible.
requirements.test_case: With the lamp installed in the bumper on the vehicle, check that the approval marking (and any LED substitute light source category) is visible, if necessary with the hood or a door opened.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body, if the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body.
requirements.test_case: If the outer lens of the lamp is detachable, inspect both the lens and the main body for the approval marking.

requirements.text: The main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device in case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings.
requirements.test_case: Where one outer lens covers several devices with different approval markings, inspect each main body and confirm it bears only the approval marking of its own function(s).

requirements.text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp and confirm that the approval marking and the markings of paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. are affixed on the lamp.

requirements.text: The component shall have the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.5.(a) affixed on it.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the light source module component and confirm that the markings of paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a) are affixed on it.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number is affixed to grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, the single approval mark shall be visible after the installation of the lamps.
requirements.test_case: With the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamp installed in the bumper, check that the single approval mark is visible.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number is affixed to grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light shall be capable of being removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp construction and confirm that no light-transmitting part can be removed without also removing the part carrying the single approval mark.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the components of the single approval mark and compare them with the minimum size required for the smallest individual mark under the pertinent Regulations.

requirements.text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.test_case: Verify by type-approval testing of the side signalling lamp samples that all requirements of paragraphs 4. and 5. of R148 are met.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp design and its intended installation in the bumper against sections 5 and 6 (and referenced Annexes) of UN R48 in the series of amendments in force at the time of application.

requirements.text: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Verify at lamp type approval the R48 requirements pertinent to the side signalling lamp and to M1 vehicles that can be checked on the lamp (e.g. geometric visibility angles).

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which the lamps may be subjected in such use, the satisfactory operation of the lamps remains assured and the lamps retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Subject the lamp mounted in the bumper to a vibration test and confirm afterwards that it operates satisfactorily and still meets the photometric and colorimetric requirements.

requirements.text: The position lamps or daytime running lamps, which are reciprocally incorporated with another function, using a common light source, and designed to operate permanently with an additional system to regulate the intensity of the light emitted, shall be permitted.
requirements.test_case: Where a position lamp or daytime running lamp shares a common light source with another function, check that it operates permanently with an additional intensity-regulating system.

requirements.text: Where a front position lamp incorporates one or more infrared radiation generators, the photometric and colour requirements for this front position lamp shall be met with and without the operation of the infrared radiation generator(s).
requirements.test_case: Measure the photometry and colour of the front position lamp with the infrared generator(s) switched on and switched off and confirm compliance in both states.

requirements.text: The internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) shall fulfill all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation when incorporating only one manufacturer logo built by transparent or non-transparent components on request of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: For a lamp with an incorporated manufacturer logo, test the lamp function and confirm all its R148 requirements are met with the logo present and that only one logo is incorporated.

requirements.text: The internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) shall incorporate only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer, irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., when incorporating only one manufacturer logo built by transparent or non-transparent components on request of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Check that any logo in the lamp is the brand logo of the vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer, confirmed by the vehicle manufacturer's statement.

requirements.text: The enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of a lamp, where the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of the lamp incorporates only one manufacturer logo built by transparent or non-transparent components on request of the applicant, shall not exceed 100 cm2 in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Measure the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo projected in the direction of the reference axis and confirm it does not exceed 100 cm2.

requirements.text: The logo light emitting surface (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) shall not be required to be symmetrical by itself, notwithstanding the requirements of paragraph 5.5.2. of UN Regulation No. 48, when the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) incorporates only one manufacturer logo built by transparent or non-transparent components on request of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Review the logo design and confirm that symmetry of the logo light emitting surface by itself is not used as an acceptance criterion while the lamp pair otherwise meets UN R48 paragraph 5.5.2.

requirements.text: Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the direction indicator lamp in the bumper and confirm that no logo is incorporated in its optical components or outer lens.

requirements.text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
requirements.test_case: Review the LED wiring diagram of the lamp and confirm that series-wired LED groups whose single failure extinguishes the whole group are treated as one light source in the failure analysis.

requirements.text: If any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source fails, then the single lamp shall ensure that at least one of the following provisions applies: (a) the light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or (b) a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced.
requirements.test_case: Disconnect each light source of the side signalling lamp in turn and confirm that either the minimum intensities of Annex 3 are still met (and maximums are not exceeded with all sources on) or a failure tell-tale signal is produced.

requirements.text: For direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12, instead of the requirements of paragraph 4.6.1.2. and in addition to the requirements of paragraph 4.6.1.1., the lamp shall produce a signal for activation of the tell-tale prescribed in paragraph 6.5.8. of Regulation No. 48 or paragraph 6.3.8. of Regulation No. 53 on the basis of either option a), b) or c) (notwithstanding the provisions stated in paragraph 4.6.): (a) any one light source has failed; (b) in the case of a lamp designed for only two light sources, the intensity in the axis of reference is less than 50 per cent of the minimum intensity required; (c) as a consequence of a failure of one or more light sources, the intensity in one of the following directions as indicated in paragraph 2.1. of Annex 3, is less than the minimum intensity required: (i) H=0°, V=0°; (ii) H=20° outwards to the outside of the vehicle, V= +5°; (iii) H=10° inwards to the inside of the vehicle, V= 0°.
requirements.test_case: Simulate light source failures in the direction indicator lamp and confirm that the tell-tale activation signal is produced according to the chosen option a), b) or c), checking the intensities at H=0°/V=0°, H=20° out/V=+5° and H=10° in/V=0° for option c).

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Review the lamp bill of materials and confirm it uses only light sources approved to UN R37, R99 and/or R128 without use restriction, light source modules and/or non-replaceable light sources.

requirements.text: Where replaceable UN approved light source(s) are used, the design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to insert the replaceable light source in every possible orientation and confirm it can only be fixed in the correct position.

requirements.text: Where replaceable UN approved light source(s) are used, the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed applying.
requirements.test_case: Gauge the light source holder against the IEC 60061 holder data sheet for the prescribed light source category.

requirements.text: Where replaceable UN approved light source(s) are used and a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the light source(s) holder shall conform to the holder data sheet relevant to the category of LED substitute light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Where an LED substitute light source category is also prescribed, gauge the holder against the IEC 60061 holder data sheet for that LED substitute category.

requirements.text: The Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Run radiated and conducted emission tests on the lamp (e.g. to UN R10) and confirm in vehicle tests that the bumper sensors, radar, camera and other electronic systems do not malfunction while the lamp operates.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that the light source module(s) can only be fitted in the designated and correct position.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to fit each replaceable light source module in every possible orientation and position and confirm it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that the light source module(s) can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.test_case: Attempt to remove the light source module by hand without tools and confirm removal is only possible with the use of tool(s).

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that the light source module(s) is tamperproof.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the light source module design and samples to confirm it cannot be opened or tampered with without visible damage.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module(s) is not interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source and/or any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.test_case: Attempt, with and without tools, to fit any replaceable UN approved light source and any other light source module of the same lamp housing with different characteristics in the module seat and confirm it is not possible.

requirements.text: When the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, in case of replaceable light source module(s), the device shall meet the photometric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Replace the light source module with another module bearing the same identification code supplied by the applicant and repeat the photometric measurements to confirm compliance.

requirements.text: In the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, all measurements shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report to confirm that all photometric and colorimetric measurements of a lamp with replaceable UN approved light sources were made with standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.

requirements.text: The lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) shall have all measurements made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report to confirm that all measurements were made with the light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) present in the lamp.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp (function) using light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., the photometric measurements shall be made separately, in accordance with each applicable condition(s) set forth in paragraph 4.8.
requirements.test_case: Check that for a lamp with light sources under different conditions of paragraph 4.8. the photometric measurements were made separately per applicable condition.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp (function) using light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., all separate measurement results shall be added together.
requirements.test_case: Check in the test report that the separately measured luminous intensities were added together to give the result for the lamp (function).

requirements.text: In the case where the lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions, the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Repeat the photometric measurements at each installation position, or at the extreme positions of the reference axis field declared by the manufacturer, and confirm compliance in each.

requirements.text: In the case where the lamp, at the discretion of the applicant, also has to be approved with LED substitute light source(s), all measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be repeated using the LED substitute light source(s) prescribed.
requirements.test_case: Where approval with LED substitute light sources is requested, repeat all photometric and colorimetric measurements with the prescribed LED substitute light source(s) and confirm compliance.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
requirements.test_case: Check the photometric test set-up and report to confirm the intensities were measured with the light source continuously lit unless another mode is specified.

requirements.text: When the results of measurements are challenged, the intensity requirement for a particular direction of observation shall be deemed to be satisfied if that requirement is met in a direction deviating by not more than one-quarter of a degree from the direction of observation.
requirements.test_case: In a challenged measurement, measure the intensity within one-quarter of a degree of the direction of observation and confirm the requirement is met in at least one such direction.

requirements.text: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of a light-signalling lamp shall be determined, except that this requirement shall not apply to rear-registration plate illuminating lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check that the approval drawings and test report define the limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the lamp.

requirements.text: In the case of category 5 and 6 direction indicators, the limits of the light emitting surface shall be determined.
requirements.test_case: Check that the approval drawings and test report of the category 5 or 6 direction indicator define the limits of the light emitting surface.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the lamp shall be operated for testing at a voltage supplied at the lamp of either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.test_case: Measure the supply voltage at the lamp terminals during photometric testing and confirm it is 6.75 V, 13.5 V or 28 V for the respective system.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Check that the lamp with electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control was operated during testing with the supply conditions specified by the applicant.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Check that the lamp with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) and no control gear was operated during testing as specified by the applicant.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction on the measured luminous intensities.
requirements.test_case: Check that the replaceable light sources were operated at the reference/objective luminous flux, or that the measured intensities were proportionally corrected for the flux used.

requirements.text: In case of lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources, the lamps shall be operated at a voltage or electrical current setting such that the actual luminous fluxes of the light sources do not deviate by more than 5 per cent from the average luminous flux of the light sources, except that alternatively the lamps may be tested by using one light source in each of the individual lamp holder positions operating at the reference/objective luminous flux and application of the sum of the measured luminous intensities for each direction.
requirements.test_case: Measure the luminous flux of each light source at the chosen voltage or current setting and confirm none deviates by more than 5 per cent from the average, or check the alternative one-source-per-holder method was applied.

requirements.text: In case of lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources, the measured luminous intensities shall be corrected proportionally for the difference between the average luminous flux and the applicable reference/objective luminous flux.
requirements.test_case: Check in the test report that the measured luminous intensities were corrected by the ratio of the reference/objective luminous flux to the average luminous flux.

requirements.text: The intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, if not otherwise specified, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure the luminous intensity of both samples at HV and confirm it is not less than the minimum in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.

requirements.text: The intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, if not otherwise specified and in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Scan the luminous intensity of both samples over all directions where the lamp is visible and confirm no value exceeds the maximum in the table of the pertinent function.

requirements.text: The intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, if not otherwise specified, outside the reference axis, be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5., by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question, or be not less than the intensity value as specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
requirements.test_case: Measure both samples at every grid point of the pertinent Annex 3 light distribution figure and confirm each value meets the percentage of the minimum or the specified intensity value.

requirements.text: The intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, if not otherwise specified and within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure both samples throughout the angles of geometric visibility of the pertinent Annex 2 table and confirm the intensity is not less than the minimum specified for the function.

requirements.text: The intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall be observed in accordance with the provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity.
requirements.test_case: Check the measured light distribution of both samples against the Annex 3 provisions on local variations of intensity.

requirements.text: When an assembly of two independent lamps, to be type approved as lamps marked "D" and having the same function, is deemed to be a single lamp, the assembly shall comply with the requirements for maximum intensity if all lamps together are lit.
requirements.test_case: Light both lamps of the "D" assembly together and confirm the maximum intensity requirements are not exceeded.

requirements.text: When an assembly of two independent lamps, to be type approved as lamps marked "D" and having the same function, is deemed to be a single lamp, the assembly shall comply with the requirements for minimum intensity if either lamp has failed.
requirements.test_case: Switch off each lamp of the "D" assembly in turn and confirm the remaining lamp meets the minimum intensity requirements.

requirements.text: When all its interdependent lamps are operated together, the interdependent lamp system shall meet the requirements.
requirements.test_case: Operate all interdependent lamps of the system together and confirm the photometric, colorimetric and geometric visibility requirements are met.

requirements.text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Check that the luminous intensity compliance tests were performed with the operating times and procedure of Annex 8.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates at points inside the Annex 3 light distribution grid of the function and confirm they are within the prescribed colour limits.

requirements.text: The lamp shall exhibit no sharp variation of colour outside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
requirements.test_case: Visually and colorimetrically inspect the light outside the Annex 3 grid field and confirm there is no sharp variation of colour.

requirements.text: For lamps (functions) using different light source technologies, the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions in paragraphs 4.8.1. and 4.8.2.
requirements.test_case: Supply each light source technology of the lamp separately and measure the colour of each according to paragraphs 4.8.1. and 4.8.2.

requirements.text: In the case of direction indicators of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12, the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 8, with the minimum luminous intensities fulfilled in the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Measure both samples of the direction indicator and confirm the Table 8 values for its category, with the minimum luminous intensity checked in the reference axis.

requirements.text: In the case of direction indicators of categories 5 and 6, the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 8, with the minimum luminous intensities fulfilled in direction A according to Annex 2.
requirements.test_case: Measure both samples of the category 5 or 6 direction indicator and confirm the Table 8 values, with the minimum luminous intensity checked in direction A according to Annex 2.

requirements.text: The direction indicator of category 5 shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 6∙10⁻¹ cd, a maximum luminous intensity of 2.80∙10² cd when used as a single lamp or 1.40∙10² cd when used as a lamp marked "D", a standard light distribution as defined in Table A2-2, and a minimum luminous intensity of 6∙10⁻¹ cd within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-2, as given in Table 8.
requirements.test_case: Measure both category 5 samples in direction A, over all visible directions and within the Table A2-2 field and confirm minimum 6∙10⁻¹ cd and maximum 2.80∙10² cd (1.40∙10² cd for "D").

requirements.text: The direction indicator of category 6 shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 5.0∙10¹ cd, a maximum luminous intensity of 2.80∙10² cd when used as a single lamp or 1.40∙10² cd when used as a lamp marked "D", and a standard light distribution as defined in Figure A3-IV, as given in Table 8.
requirements.test_case: Measure both category 6 samples in direction A and over the Figure A3-IV grid and confirm minimum 5.0∙10¹ cd and maximum 2.80∙10² cd (1.40∙10² cd for "D").

requirements.text: The intensities of the direction indicator lamp shall in general be measured with the light source(s) continuously alight, except that depending on the construction of the lamp, for example, the use of light-emitting diodes (LED), or the need to take precautions to avoid overheating, it is allowed to measure the lamps in flashing mode.
requirements.test_case: Check that the direction indicator was measured with the light source(s) continuously alight, or that flashing-mode measurement was justified by the lamp construction.

requirements.text: When the direction indicator lamp is measured in flashing mode, the flashing mode shall be achieved by switching with a frequency of f = 1.5 ± 0.5 Hz with the pulse width greater than 0.3 s, measured at 95 per cent peak light intensity.
requirements.test_case: Record the light output during flashing-mode measurement and confirm a frequency of 1.5 ± 0.5 Hz and a pulse width above 0.3 s at 95 per cent peak intensity.

requirements.text: When the direction indicator lamp is measured in flashing mode, in all other cases the voltage as required in paragraph 4.8. shall be switched with a rise time and fall time shorter than 0.01 s.
requirements.test_case: Record the supply voltage waveform with an oscilloscope during flashing-mode measurement and confirm rise and fall times shorter than 0.01 s.

requirements.text: When the direction indicator lamp is measured in flashing mode, the switched voltage as required in paragraph 4.8. shall have no overshoot.
requirements.test_case: Record the supply voltage waveform with an oscilloscope during flashing-mode measurement and confirm there is no overshoot.

requirements.text: When measurements of the direction indicator lamp are taken in flashing mode, the reported luminous intensity shall be represented by the maximum intensity.
requirements.test_case: Check that the luminous intensities reported for flashing-mode measurements are the maximum intensities recorded.

requirements.text: Where the flash of direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12 is produced by sequential activation of their light sources, the direction indicator lamps shall meet the conditions (a) to (e) of paragraph 5.6.5.
requirements.test_case: For a sequential direction indicator, verify in flashing mode each of the conditions (a) to (e) of paragraph 5.6.5.

requirements.text: Where the flash of a direction indicator lamp of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12 is produced by sequential activation of its light sources, each light source, after its activation, shall remain lit until the end of the ON cycle.
requirements.test_case: Record the sequential flash with a high-speed camera or photodiodes and confirm each light source stays lit from its activation until the end of the ON cycle.

requirements.text: Where the flash of a direction indicator lamp of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12 is produced by sequential activation of its light sources, the sequence of activation of the light sources shall produce a signal which proceeds in a uniform progressive manner from inboard towards the outboard edge of the light emitting surface.
requirements.test_case: Record the activation sequence and confirm the signal proceeds uniformly and progressively from the inboard to the outboard edge of the light emitting surface.

requirements.text: Where the flash of a direction indicator lamp of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12 is produced by sequential activation of its light sources, the signal shall be one signal with no interruption and no vertical oscillations (e.g. not more than one change of direction along the vertical axis).
requirements.test_case: Record the sequential signal and confirm it is a single uninterrupted signal with at most one change of direction along the vertical axis.

requirements.text: Where the flash of a direction indicator lamp of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12 is produced by sequential activation of its light sources, the distance between two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the light emitting surface of the sequential direction indicator shall not exceed 50mm, when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, instead of the values defined in paragraph 5.7.2. of UN Regulation No. 48 or paragraph 5.7.2. of UN Regulation No. 86 or paragraph 5.6.2. of UN Regulation No. 53.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the drawing or sample the gap between adjacent distinct parts of the light emitting surface perpendicular to the reference axis and confirm it does not exceed 50 mm.

requirements.text: Where the flash of a direction indicator lamp of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12 is produced by sequential activation of its light sources, the interruptions of the signal shall not create any overlap in the vertical axis between the different parts, from inboard towards the outboard of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the projection of the distinct parts of the light emitting surface and confirm the gaps create no vertical overlap between parts from inboard to outboard.

requirements.text: Where the flash of a direction indicator lamp of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12 is produced by sequential activation of its light sources, the interruptions of the signal shall not be used for any other lighting or light signalling functions.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp design and confirm no other lighting or light-signalling function is placed in the gaps between the parts of the sequential direction indicator.

requirements.text: Where the flash of a direction indicator lamp of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12 is produced by sequential activation of its light sources, the variation shall finish no more than 200ms after the beginning of the ON cycle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the time from the start of the ON cycle until the last light source is lit and confirm it is no more than 200 ms.

requirements.text: Where the flash of a direction indicator lamp of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12 is produced by sequential activation of its light sources, the orthogonal projection of the light emitting surfaces of the direction indicator in the direction of the axis of reference shall be circumscribed by a rectangle on a plane normal to the axis of reference and having its longer sides parallel to the H-plane.
requirements.test_case: Project the light emitting surfaces along the axis of reference on the drawing and confirm the circumscribing rectangle has its longer sides parallel to the H-plane.

requirements.text: Where the flash of a direction indicator lamp of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12 is produced by sequential activation of its light sources, the ratio of the horizontal to the vertical sides of the rectangle circumscribing the orthogonal projection of the light emitting surfaces shall not be less than 1.7.
requirements.test_case: Measure the horizontal and vertical sides of the circumscribing rectangle and confirm their ratio is not less than 1.7.

requirements.text: Where the flash of a direction indicator lamp of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12 is produced by sequential activation of its light sources, compliance to the conditions (a) to (e) shall be verified in flashing mode.
requirements.test_case: Check that the sequential activation conditions were verified with the lamp operated in flashing mode.

requirements.text: The light emitted by the direction indicator lamp shall be amber.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of the direction indicator light and confirm they fall within the amber colour limits.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the side marker lamp supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 9 for luminous intensity and standard light distribution.
requirements.test_case: Measure both side marker lamp samples on the goniophotometer and confirm the values of Table 9 for the lamp category are met.

requirements.text: For red side marker lamps, in the angular field from 60° to 90° in horizontal direction and ±20° in vertical direction towards the front of the vehicle, the maximum intensity shall be limited to 2.5∙10⁻¹ cd.
requirements.test_case: Measure the red side marker lamp over the field 60° to 90° horizontal and ±20° vertical towards the front and confirm no value exceeds 2.5∙10⁻¹ cd.

requirements.text: The side marker lamp of category SM1 shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 4.0∙10⁰ cd in the axis of reference, a minimum luminous intensity of 6∙10⁻¹ cd within the standard light distribution of Figure A3-VII, a maximum luminous intensity of 2.50∙10¹ cd and a minimum luminous intensity of 6∙10⁻¹ cd within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-3, as given in Table 9.
requirements.test_case: Measure both SM1 samples in the axis of reference, over Figure A3-VII and within the Table A2-3 field and confirm minimum 4.0∙10⁰ cd on axis, 6∙10⁻¹ cd elsewhere and maximum 2.50∙10¹ cd.

requirements.text: The side marker lamp of category SM2 shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 6∙10⁻¹ cd in the axis of reference, a minimum luminous intensity of 6∙10⁻¹ cd within the standard light distribution of Figure A3-VIII, a maximum luminous intensity of 2.50∙10¹ cd and a minimum luminous intensity of 6∙10⁻¹ cd within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-3, as given in Table 9.
requirements.test_case: Measure both SM2 samples in the axis of reference, over Figure A3-VIII and within the Table A2-3 field and confirm minimum 6∙10⁻¹ cd and maximum 2.50∙10¹ cd.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the side marker lamp shall be amber, except that the light emitted can be red, if the rearmost side marker lamp is grouped or combined or reciprocally incorporated with the rear position lamp, the rear end-outline marker lamp, the rear fog lamp, the stop lamp, or is grouped with or has part of the light emitting surface in common with the rear retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of the side marker lamp light and confirm they fall within the amber limits, or within the red limits for a rearmost side marker lamp grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated as listed.

requirements.text: Lamps shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Compare production samples of the side signalling lamp against the approved type documentation (drawings, description, photometric and colorimetric results) and confirm they conform to the type approved.

requirements.text: The measured values shall not deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure the photometric values of production lamps and confirm no value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the values prescribed in the Regulation.

requirements.text: The measured values shall correspond to the values shown in Table 12 for the minimum values required throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3.
requirements.test_case: For each minimum value required in the fields of Annexes 2 and 3, check that the measured luminous intensity of production lamps is at least the equivalent 20 per cent value given in Table 12.

requirements.text: The side direction indicators (5) shall have horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 5° / 55° (A/B), the horizontal angles applying to direction A, and minimum vertical angles of 15° / 15° (above/below), except that reduced vertical angles of 15° / 5° (above/below) are used for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm, as given in Table A2-2.
requirements.test_case: Measure the side direction indicator on a goniophotometer and confirm the required minimum intensity is met over 5° / 55° horizontally in direction A and 15° up / 15° down vertically (15° up / 5° down if the H-plane is below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The side marker lamps of category SM1 shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° / 45° (A/B) and minimum vertical angles of 10° / 10° (above/below), except that reduced vertical angles of 10° / 5° (above/below) are used for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm, as given in Table A2-3.
requirements.test_case: Measure the SM1 side marker lamp on a goniophotometer and confirm the required minimum intensity is met over 45° / 45° horizontally and 10° up / 10° down vertically (10° up / 5° down if the H-plane is below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The side marker lamps of category SM2 shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 30° / 30° (A/B) and minimum vertical angles of 10° / 10° (above/below), except that reduced vertical angles of 10° / 5° (above/below) are used for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm, as given in Table A2-3.
requirements.test_case: Measure the SM2 side marker lamp on a goniophotometer and confirm the required minimum intensity is met over 30° / 30° horizontally and 10° up / 10° down vertically (10° up / 5° down if the H-plane is below 750 mm).

requirements.text: Unless specified otherwise, the minimum intensities given by the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV for the various directions of measurement, as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.
requirements.test_case: Recalculate the minimum intensity for each measuring direction from the Annex 3 percentages and confirm the values used for evaluation are rounded down to three significant digits.

requirements.text: Where side marker lamps are intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the manufacturer's specified H-plane mounting height of the side marker lamp and, if it is 750 mm or less, confirm the photometric measurement grid is evaluated only down to 5° below the horizontal.

requirements.text: The light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage, within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid.
requirements.test_case: Scan the light distribution between the grid points on a goniophotometer and confirm the intensity in every intermediate direction is at least the lowest minimum value of the surrounding grid lines.

requirements.text: For lamps (functions) using incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Operate the incandescent lamp function until photometric stability is reached, measure the luminous intensities at the prescribed test points and confirm each value lies within the minimum and maximum requirements.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps and manoeuvring lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Switch the non-incandescent reversing or manoeuvring lamp ON, measure the luminous intensities after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation and confirm both sets of values lie within the minimum and maximum requirements.

requirements.text: For all other lamps (other than reversing lamps and manoeuvring lamps) using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation, or after photometric stability has occurred, shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Operate the non-incandescent side signalling lamp function, measure the luminous intensities after 1 min and after 30 minutes of operation (or after photometric stability) and confirm both sets of values lie within the minimum and maximum requirements.

requirements.text: When the luminous intensities of direction indicator lamps are measured, the direction indicator lamps shall be operated in flashing mode (f = 1.5 Hz, duty factor 50 per cent).
requirements.test_case: Check the photometric test record and the supply signal to confirm the direction indicator lamp was operated in flashing mode at 1.5 Hz with a 50 per cent duty factor during the luminous intensity measurements.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity distribution shall, depending on the light source technology and in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1, where the luminous intensity distributions at a point in time may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured according to paragraph 1 by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at the reference coordinate of the lamp (function) under consideration.
requirements.test_case: Measure (or calculate by the HV/reference-coordinate ratio) the luminous intensity distribution at the time after switch ON given in Table A8-1 for the lamp function (e.g. 0.2 s for direction indicators, 4 s for side-marker lamps) and confirm it complies with the intensity requirements.

requirements.text: Where a lamp (function) uses incandescent technology only, the lamp (function) shall be deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.1. are compliant.
requirements.test_case: For an incandescent-only lamp function, verify that the luminous intensities measured after photometric stability according to paragraph 1.1. are compliant and record compliance at all points in time on that basis.

requirements.text: Where a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, the lamp (function) shall be deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.
requirements.test_case: For an LED-only lamp function, verify that the luminous intensities measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant and record compliance at all points in time on that basis.

requirements.text: Where a lamp (function) uses any other light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of the lamp (function) shall be tested and checked for compliance at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
requirements.test_case: For a lamp function using another light generating technology, measure the luminous intensities from the Table A8-1 point in time after switch ON until photometric stability is reached and confirm all values comply with the intensity requirements.

requirements.text: Where a lamp (function) uses more than one light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of the lamp (function) shall be tested following the strictest time requirements according to paragraphs 2.1.1. to 2.1.3. for the combination of them and checked for compliance.
requirements.test_case: For a lamp function combining light generating technologies, identify the strictest time requirement among paragraphs 2.1.1. to 2.1.3., measure the luminous intensities at those points in time and confirm compliance.

requirements.text: If there is doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), then the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of the lamp (function) shall be tested and checked for compliance at all points in time starting at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
requirements.test_case: Where run-up behaviour is unexpected, record the luminous intensity continuously from the Table A8-1 point in time after switch ON until photometric stability and confirm the minimum intensity requirements are met throughout.

requirements.text: The sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp samples for a clear, indelible trade name or mark and type designation.

requirements.text: Where an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall either specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128, granted to this ESA, or provide a test report by a Technical Service designated by the Type Approval Authority, stating that this ESA is not mechanically interchangeable with any light source according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: Check the file contains an R37/R99/R128 approval number or a Technical Service report confirming the LED module is not mechanically interchangeable with such light sources.

requirements.text: If an ESA is (part of) a light source and the documentation as specified in paragraph 3.2.10. is missing, then approval of this ESA according to Regulation No. 10 shall not be granted.
requirements.test_case: Verify the paragraph 3.2.10 documentation is present before R10 approval is granted.

requirements.text: For every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation, an approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. shall be affixed to the ESA.
requirements.test_case: Inspect production lamps for the R10 approval mark.

requirements.text: For each ESA conforming to the type approved under this Regulation, an international approval mark shall be affixed on the ESA in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval mark location on the lamp matches the place specified on the communication form and is conspicuous and easily accessible.

requirements.text: The approval mark of the ESA shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the mark for a circle with letter E and the distinguishing number of the approving country.

requirements.text: The approval mark of the ESA shall comprise the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the mark for '10R-' followed by the approval number to the right of the circle.

requirements.text: The ESA shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review the lamp EMC design and test results showing compliance with all applicable R10 requirements.

requirements.text: The ESA shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions and for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the test report covers radiated and conducted emission and radiated and conducted immunity tests of the lamp.

requirements.text: For broadband emissions, the electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband radiated emission of the lamp per Annex 7.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Verify broadband emission between 30 and 75 MHz is below 62-52 dBuV/m (E = 62 - 25.13 log(F/30)).

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limit shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.test_case: Verify broadband emission between 400 and 1,000 MHz is below 63 dBuV/m.

requirements.text: For the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Compare all measured broadband values with the limit line and confirm they are below it.

requirements.text: For narrowband emissions, the electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Measure narrowband radiated emission of the lamp per Annex 8.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.test_case: Verify narrowband emission between 30 and 75 MHz is below 52-42 dBuV/m (E = 52 - 25.13 log(F/30)).

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limit shall remain constant at 53 dB microvolts/m in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.test_case: Verify narrowband emission between 400 and 1,000 MHz is below 53 dBuV/m.

requirements.text: For the ESA representative of its type, the measured value, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Compare all measured narrowband values with the limit line and confirm they are below it.

requirements.text: The emission of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Measure conducted transient emission on the lamp supply lines per ISO 7637-2 / Annex 10.

requirements.text: For vehicles with 12 V systems, the maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude of transient conducted emission of the ESA shall be +75 V (Table 1).
requirements.test_case: Verify positive transient pulses generated by the lamp on a 12 V supply do not exceed +75 V.

requirements.text: For vehicles with 12 V systems, the maximum allowed negative pulse amplitude of transient conducted emission of the ESA shall be -100 V (Table 1).
requirements.test_case: Verify negative transient pulses generated by the lamp on a 12 V supply do not exceed -100 V.

requirements.text: For vehicles with 24 V systems, the maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude of transient conducted emission of the ESA shall be +150 V (Table 1).
requirements.test_case: Verify positive transient pulses generated by the lamp on a 24 V supply do not exceed +150 V.

requirements.text: For vehicles with 24 V systems, the maximum allowed negative pulse amplitude of transient conducted emission of the ESA shall be -450 V (Table 1).
requirements.test_case: Verify negative transient pulses generated by the lamp on a 24 V supply do not exceed -450 V.

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
requirements.test_case: Confirm radiated immunity tests were performed with method(s) chosen from Annex 9.

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) as described in Annex 9 with the test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2a and the test severity for the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2b.
requirements.test_case: Verify the applied immunity levels meet Table 2a over 90 % of the band and Table 2b over the whole 20-6,000 MHz band.

requirements.text: For the Stripline method, the immunity test level for the ESA below 2 GHz (20 to 400 MHz) in over 90 per cent of the frequency band shall be 60 V/m (Table 2a).
requirements.test_case: Verify the Stripline immunity test was run at 60 V/m over at least 90 % of 20 to 400 MHz without degradation.

requirements.text: For the Stripline method, the minimum immunity test level for the ESA below 2 GHz (20 to 400 MHz) over the whole frequency band shall be 50 V/m (Table 2b).
requirements.test_case: Verify the Stripline immunity test level never fell below 50 V/m over 20 to 400 MHz.

requirements.text: For the TEM cell method, the immunity test level for the ESA below 2 GHz (20 to 200 MHz) in over 90 per cent of the frequency band shall be 75 V/m (Table 2a).
requirements.test_case: Verify the TEM cell immunity test was run at 75 V/m over at least 90 % of 20 to 200 MHz without degradation.

requirements.text: For the TEM cell method, the minimum immunity test level for the ESA below 2 GHz (20 to 200 MHz) over the whole frequency band shall be 62,5 V/m (Table 2b).
requirements.test_case: Verify the TEM cell immunity test level never fell below 62,5 V/m over 20 to 200 MHz.

requirements.text: For the BCI method, the immunity test level for the ESA below 2 GHz (20 to 400 MHz) in over 90 per cent of the frequency band shall be 60 mA (Table 2a).
requirements.test_case: Verify the BCI immunity test was run at 60 mA over at least 90 % of 20 to 400 MHz without degradation.

requirements.text: For the BCI method, the minimum immunity test level for the ESA below 2 GHz (20 to 400 MHz) over the whole frequency band shall be 50 mA (Table 2b).
requirements.test_case: Verify the BCI immunity test level never fell below 50 mA over 20 to 400 MHz.

requirements.text: For the ALSE method, the immunity test level for the ESA below 2 GHz (80 to 2,000 MHz) in over 90 per cent of the frequency band shall be 30 V/m (Table 2a).
requirements.test_case: Verify the ALSE immunity test was run at 30 V/m over at least 90 % of 80 to 2,000 MHz without degradation.

requirements.text: For the ALSE method, the minimum immunity test level for the ESA below 2 GHz (80 to 2,000 MHz) over the whole frequency band shall be 25 V/m (Table 2b).
requirements.test_case: Verify the ALSE immunity test level never fell below 25 V/m over 80 to 2,000 MHz.
